programme.title: MadS
programme.desc: Eighteen-year-old Romain has just graduated and makes a stop at his dealer's place to try a new pill. As he heads off to a party, he sees an injured woman on the side of the road and decides to help her, but when she gets in his car, she suddenly smashes her own head against the dashboard, bleeding out until she dies.

programme.title: Blood Glacier
programme.desc: Scientists discover that a red liquid leaking from a nearby glacier contains organisms that turn living hosts into deadly mutants.

programme.title: The Hallow
programme.desc: A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.

programme.title: Superdeep
programme.desc: In 1984 a Russian research team goes below the surface to find out what secret the world's deepest borehole is hiding. On their expedition, something unexpectedly gruesome awaits the researchers.

programme.desc: A skeptical American is stranded in the middle of a zombie-infected Africa and must rely on the help of three mysterious strangers to make it out alive.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: Teenage delinquents who are living in an island youth center wake up to find themselves alone with no one to watch over them. After much partying, they realize the island has been deserted and the adults have been infected by a mysterious epidemic.

programme.title: Dead Shack
programme.desc: On a weekend getaway at a rundown cottage in the woods, a 14-year-old teen, his best friend, and his best friend's older sister must work together to save their hard-partying parents from their predatory person in the cabin next to them.

programme.title: Mandrake
programme.desc: Probation officer Cathy Madden is given the task of rehabilitating notorious killer "Bloody" Mary Laidlaw back into society after 20 years in jail. Cathy's beliefs are firmly tested when two children disappear near Mary's farm.

programme.title: Infested

programme.title: Blood Quantum
programme.desc: The dead are coming back to life and almost all of Earth's population is decimated due to a zombie virus, except for the isolated Mi'kmaq reserve of Red Crow, whose indigenous inhabitants are strangely immune to the zombie plague.

programme.title: Virus-32
programme.desc: A virus spreads throughout the city, causing the infected to become vicious hunters. Iris and her daughter become caught in the massacre, discovering 32-second periods of calm before each attack.

programme.title: Almost Human
programme.desc: Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.

programme.title: The Sadness
programme.desc: As Taiwan succumbs to a viral pandemic that transforms peaceful citizens into sadistic, bloodthirsty maniacs, a young couple must battle to be reunited before they too become infected.

programme.title: Devil's Pass
programme.desc: To determine what happened to some Russian hikers, five U.S. college students go back to where the hikers were found dead. The students don't return from the expedition, either, and the recovered footage is deemed too disturbing for public viewing.

programme.title: Crossfire Trail
programme.desc: Rafe Covington (Tom Selleck), a hardened drifter, makes a promise to a dying friend to care for his Wyoming ranch and his wife, Anne (Virginia Madsen). Covington travels to Wyoming with his friends, Rock Mullaney (David O'Hara) and J.T. Langston (Christian Kane), where he tells Anne of her husband's death. They begin rehabilitating the ranch, but after a fatal gunfight, Covington and his men are given an ultimatum: leave town in three days or suffer the consequences.

programme.title: Conagher
programme.desc: Pioneer woman Evie Teale is headed west with her family to start a new life, only to have her husband, Jacob, tragically die during the journey. Left to fend for herself and her two children in the middle of nowhere, Evie strikes up a friendship with cowboy Conn Conagher, who passes by while she's working as a food server. And Conagher certainly can help, as the area is under constant threat of attack, be it from Apaches or local bandits.

programme.title: Fear Itself
programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: The Joining
programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.title: To Tell The Truth
programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.title: Mary 25
programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Final Exam
programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.title: Monster
programme.desc: Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

programme.title: The Origin Of Species
programme.desc: When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they've all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to "Double Helix"

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: A battle cruiser is captured by the enemy Ebonites on planet N-1-8-4. Imprisoned, the crew is interrogated by The Voice, an unseen Ebonite. Who will be the first to snap? And what will happen then? Starring Maurice Dean Wint and Steven Bauer.

programme.title: Lithia
programme.desc: In the world of 2055, men are extinct. Preserved by cryonics, a man (David Keith) awakens in Lithia, a poor matriarchy. He's welcomed, but when he upsets the natural order of things, the question arises: Can the world men be revived? And should it?

programme.title: Sarcophagus
programme.desc: When two archeologists (Lisa Zane, David Cubitt) discover a cocooned alien that suddenly begins to reanimate, the rest of the research team turns greedy, wanting to cash in on it. When the couple refuses, they find themselves numbered...or are they?

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: An alien (Rene Auberjonois) and his family live on a secure farm on Earth, where they grow their own food. Most of the aliens believe that the human race was wiped out in the war, but there is a group of humans in the woods...and they are starving!

programme.title: The Balance Of Nature
programme.desc: A doctor (Maurice Godin) creates a controversial process to reverse aging and disease. So, when an older woman (Barbara Rush) he loves is close to death, he knows he can save her. But there is always a price to be paid...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Phobos Rising
programme.desc: On Mars, the Free Alliance and the Coalition of Middle-Eastern and Pacific States mine minerals under a truce until an apparent attack on Earth. Without clear evidence of war, is retaliation wise, or hasty? Barbara Eve Harris and Adam Baldwin star.

programme.title: Black Box
programme.desc: A former soldier (Ron Perlman) has horrifying flashbacks from his days as a member of a covert branch of the military. But when flashback star to become reality, he wonders whether he is insane...or if there a new covert mission afoot.

programme.title: In Our Own Image
programme.desc: Mac 27 (Nicolas Lea) is Innobotics' newest android. He's emotionless, but he escapes after a glitch and takes a hostage, Celia (Nana Visitor). She sees human qualities in Mac and tries to convince him that he has feelings. But why help her captor?

programme.title: Alien Radio
programme.desc: Joe Pantoliano stars as a shock-jock whose specialty is ridiculing UFO believers. But when a true Believer sets himself on fire in front of Stan, the D.J. finds the very foundation of his disbelief beginning to crumble. Cynthia Nixon also stars.

programme.title: Donor
programme.desc: When a cancer-ridden doctor (Robert Hayes) is given a full-body transplant, he soon develops disturbing visions of a life he never led, of loves he's never experienced... and of a shocking, brutal murder. Wendel Meldrum and Thomas Cavanaugh also star.

programme.title: Small Friends
programme.desc: A brilliant inventor (Ralph Waite) who murdered a man who stole credit for his work, is double crossed by the other inmates in jail when they discover his "small friends" -- microscopic machines --can seve just about any purposeï¿½including jailbreak.

programme.title: The Grell
programme.desc: The Grell had come to earth not as equals, but as slaves. Now, an uprising has gripped the world in fear, and a high-ranking government official (Ted Shackelford), who is lost in Grell territory, experiences firsthand the ugly face of racism.

programme.title: The Other Side
programme.desc: Dr. Eberhardt (Ralph Macchio) discovers a way for comatose patients to communicate with each other by interfacing with a computer. But when he hooks himself up to the machine, he discovers a cyberspace "paradise" he may never be able to leave!

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson -- who starred in the very first episode of the classic series -- returns to the Outer Limits as an aging astronaut whose 1963 mission was a career-ending disaster. If he can just get back to space, perhaps he can clear his name.

programme.title: The Human Operators
programme.desc: Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

programme.title: Blank Slate
programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: What Will The Neighbors Think?
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: The Shroud
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Ripper
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Tribunal
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Summit
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species...and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Descent
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: The Haven
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Dj Vu
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Starcrossed
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Better Luck Next Time
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Judgment Day
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: The Gun
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it...literally.

programme.title: Skin Deep
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before...and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Manifest Destiny
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Breaking Point
programme.desc: When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

programme.title: The Beholder
programme.desc: A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

programme.title: Seeds Of Destruction
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming ...human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: Simon Says
programme.desc: After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Stasis
programme.desc: Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

programme.title: Down To Earth
programme.desc: When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

programme.title: Inner Child
programme.desc: After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

programme.title: Glitch
programme.desc: Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real...and neither is Tom.

programme.title: Decompression
programme.desc: After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

programme.title: Abaddon
programme.desc: The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

programme.title: The Grid
programme.desc: A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

programme.title: Revival
programme.desc: A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

programme.title: Gettysburg
programme.desc: Two friends re-enacting the Battle of Gettysburg unwittingly find themselves transported back in time and taken prisoner by a deranged Confederate colonel (Meatloaf) who might not only endanger their future...but the future of the country as well.

programme.title: Something About Harry
programme.desc: A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission...a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

programme.title: Zig Zag
programme.desc: An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

programme.title: Nest
programme.desc: When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

programme.title: The Curse
programme.desc: When a ice-blue meteor plunges through the sky and lands on a dairy farm, every living thing is infected and the farm owners change...hideously!

programme.title: From Beyond
programme.desc: Humans are such easy prey! H.P. Lovecraft's classic tale of suspense becomes "a grisly amalgam of sex, shock and satire" (Newsweek) in the hands of the creators of "Re-Animator." Jeffrey Combs and Barbara Crampton star in this cult-classic!

programme.title: Child's Play (1988)
programme.desc: Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!

programme.title: The Burning
programme.desc: Gather around the campfire....to die! After a cruel joke severely disfigures him, camp caretaker Cropsy is back -- with hedge clippers in hand -- seeking revenge on those who scarred him! Can the campers save themselves before he kills them all?

programme.title: Poltergeist II: The Other Side
programme.desc: In this terrifying sequel, the spirits of the dead are still hell-bent on luring the Freeling's daughter to the other side, where lies only evil!

programme.title: Poltergeist III
programme.desc: Nancy Allen, Tom Skerritt, Zelda Rubenstein and Heather O'Rourke star in this suspense-filled conclusion to the terrifying "Poltergeist" trilogy.

programme.title: The Quatermass Xperiment
programme.desc: The streets of London are transformed into a smorgasbord for an alien creature with a taste for human flesh. Don't just panic...run for your lives!

programme.title: Queen Of Blood
programme.desc: John Saxon, Dennis Hopper and the legendary Basil Rathbone star in this atmospheric -- and influential -- sci-fi cult classic as a team of astronauts embark upon a rescue mission to Mars only to encounter a seductive alien, The Queen of Blood!

programme.title: The Angry Red Planet
programme.desc: When a rocket lands on Mars, the crew finds the planet not entirely dead. As the team begins to explore, they are attacked by horrific and demented creatures at every turn. Battling for their lives, can the survivors make it back to their ship?

programme.title: Planet Of The Vampires
programme.desc: The legendary Mario Bava directs this cult-classic tale of extra-terrestrial terror when an alien race targets a crew of unsuspecting astronauts.

programme.title: Black Sabbath
programme.desc: One of the great horror anthology films, and director Mario Bava's personal favorite of his works, "Black Sabbath" tells three short tales of horror.

programme.title: The Blood On Satan's Claw
programme.desc: Horror, suspense, and the occult mix to make this a hair-raising experience even for veteran horror fans.

programme.title: The Bloody Judge
programme.desc: Christopher Lee plays the Lord Chief Justice of 17th century England who condemns women as witches to further his political and sexual needs.

programme.title: The Conqueror Worm
programme.desc: Under the guise of a witch-hunt, the notorious "witch hunter" Matthew Hopkins and his henchmen ravage and plunder a lawless England. Innocent men and women are tortured and put to death for being witches...but one man is determined to stop them.

programme.title: The Fall Of The House Of Usher (1960)
programme.desc: For the Ushers, their house is more than just a home...it's their tomb...as Vincent Price goes to ghastly lengths to end his family's bloodline forever.

programme.title: Pit And The Pendulum
programme.desc: Happily-ever-after goes under the knife in this horror classic, a saga of murder, madness and forbidden desire.

programme.title: The Premature Burial
programme.desc: In this ghoulish tale, Ray Milland stars as a painter whose obsessive fear of being buried alive compels him to build himself a tomb with a view!

programme.title: Tales Of Terror
programme.desc: Three short stories based on the works of Edgar Allan Poe, with Vincent Price in the starring roles and directed by the great Roger Corman.

programme.title: The Raven
programme.desc: Scream legends Vincent Price, Peter Lorre and Boris Karloff are three rival sorcerers whose paths cross when one is turned into a raven by another!

programme.title: The Haunted Palace
programme.desc: A century after a warlock was burned alive, his descendant (Vincent Price) inherits the family estate and the horrors of the past return to haunt him.

programme.title: The Masque Of The Red Death (1964)
programme.desc: Death and debauchery reign in the castle of Price Prospero (Vincent Price)...and when it reigns it pours...in this lavish Edgar Allan Poe adaptation.

programme.title: The Tomb Of Ligeia
programme.desc: Vincent Price's deceased first wife, Ligeia, casts a long shadow over his ill-advised second marriage, especially when Ligeia's spirit returns.

programme.title: The Terror
programme.desc: When a soldier encounters a haunting woman on a desolate beach, his hunt for her leads to a dark, foreboding castle and its mysterious owner.

programme.title: Reptilicus
programme.desc: Discover the true meaning of survival of the fittest as a terrifying creature from the past brings the future to its knees in this Danish-American kaiju creature feature about a cold-blooded 90-foot killer whose time has come... again!

programme.title: Yongary: Monster From The Deep
programme.desc: In South Korea's first entry into the kaiju genre, a monstrous creature creates destruction throughout Korea as scientists race against time to create a refrigerant that may be the only weapon to stop the monster before it destroys the country!

programme.title: Ghoulies
programme.desc: It's the horrifying and hilarious ride into the darkest regions of hell that started it all! When Jonathan (Peter Liapis) inherits his late father's home and finds a book of spells, he unlocks unimaginable demonic horrors!

programme.title: Ghoulies II
programme.desc: The Ghoulies are back and more devilish than ever as they turn an unsuspecting carnival into a house of pandemonium in this wildly outrageous sequel to the smash hit "Ghoulies!" Damon Martin and Royal Dano star in this cult-classic!

programme.title: The Video Dead
programme.desc: On a quiet, tree-lined street, evil has arrived through an old television set when killer zombies crawl out of a horror film and into suburbia!

programme.title: Sugar Hill
programme.desc: When a nightclub entrepreneur gets taken out by the mob, his girlfriend calls upon a voodoo high priest to carry out an unholy plan for revenge.

programme.title: The Return Of The Living Dead
programme.desc: On his first day at a medical supply warehouse, Freddy (Thom Mathews) unwittingly releases toxic gas from a secret U.S. military canister. The gas reanimates an army of corpses, who arise from their graves with a ravenous hunger...for human brains!

programme.title: An Abduction of Innocence
programme.desc: When a 10-year-old girl goes missing after a sleepover, questions of her whereabouts begin swirling.

programme.title: VPI: Vinnie Politan Investigates
programme.desc: Lindsay Clancy's ex-mother-in-law testified on her behalf as the defense continued presenting evidence in the case involving the deaths of Lindsay's three children.

programme.title: Natalie's Last Summer
programme.desc: A teenager is found strangled in a rental condo while on a graduation beach trip with friends.

programme.title: Influencer to Inmate
programme.desc: A YouTube vlogger and a counselor are pushed into the national spotlight over alleged child abuse.

programme.title: An Abduction of Innocence
programme.desc: When a 10-year-old girl goes missing after a sleepover, questions of her whereabouts begin swirling.

programme.title: The Burn Pile Murder
programme.desc: A wife and son accuse each other of murdering a prominent Georgia attorney and trying to incinerate his remains in a backyard burn pile; investigators uncover affairs and family in-fighting over money as detectives try to discern who should inherit an estate worth millions, and who should go to prison; for the first time, a juror explains how difficult it was to decide whose story to believe.

programme.title: The Matriarch Mastermind Murder
programme.desc: More than a decade after Florida State Law professor Dan Markel was gunned down by two Miami hitmen, his former mother-in-law, Donna Adelson, is accused of plotting the murder; her son Charlie and his girlfriend have already been convicted, but prosecutors believe Donna was calling the shots; will the family matriarch and doting grandmother be able to convince the jury she had nothing to do with executing her son-in-law?

programme.title: Murdaugh Family Murders
programme.desc: Once prominent South Carolina attorney Alex Murdaugh's life begins to unravel after the murder of his wife Maggie and youngest son Paul; the murders kick off an investigation that uncovered years of drug abuse, theft of millions of dollars and an abuse of power bringing down a Lowcountry legal dynasty.

programme.title: OH v. Jenkins
programme.desc: Tonica Jenkins has a talent for manipulating people to get what she wants.

programme.title: VPI: Vinnie Politan Investigates
programme.desc: Lindsay Clancy's ex-mother-in-law testified on her behalf as the defense continued presenting evidence in the case involving the deaths of Lindsay's three children.

programme.title: Spectator Slowing
programme.desc: The BAU team investigates a series of seemingly random fatal explosions throughout Kentucky and Tennessee.

programme.title: Saturday
programme.desc: The members of the BAU enjoy a Saturday off in vastly different ways; Rossi and Prentiss help Simmons assemble a new crib; Garcia leads a hacking competition; Dr. Reid strikes up a conversation with a woman named Maxine.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Following a series of fatal shootings, the BAU team travels to Illinois to investigate what appears to be a copycat serial killer.

programme.title: Decriminalized
programme.desc: The team gets called to Vermont after a married couple who grow illegal marijuana massacre their employees; Barnes begins to regret not taking any time off to bond with her new baby.

programme.title: The Illustrated Woman
programme.desc: Toby's investigation into the murder of a tattooed woman leads him to believe that corporate espionage and blackmail are behind the killing.

programme.title: Love's a Bitch
programme.desc: The murder of a British spy may be linked to an adulterous dating site.

programme.desc: Magnum and Higgins are hired to find a missing gamer whose online friends believe he might be in trouble; Jin Jeong enlists the help of TC in a treasure hunt after his ex-partner gets out of prison.

programme.title: Run With the Devil
programme.desc: Magnum and Higgins agree to help a teenage Amish boy who has traveled to Hawaii in search of his runaway sister; Rick sets out to find TC a date to the Marine Corps Ball.

programme.title: Consciousness of Guilt
programme.desc: After a high-stakes homicide case falls apart at trial, Katsumoto asks Magnum to help him stop a killer from walking free; Higgins helps Jin Jeong with a mystery of his own.

programme.title: Extracurricular Activities
programme.desc: Magnum and Higgins are hired by a University of Oahu dean to quietly investigate a professor who has been accused of having an inappropriate relationship with a female grad student; TC and Katsumoto take Cade and Dennis on a father-son camping trip.

programme.title: Through the Glass, Darkly
programme.desc: Calder is released from prison and resumes his search for Chance; Chance is reinstated as a federal marshal.

programme.title: The Fire Next Time
programme.desc: Chance Bowman (Lucky Vanous) helps a black preacher and his family when their church is burned. With Billy Dee Williams and G. Gordon Liddy.

programme.title: Games of Chance
programme.desc: Chance and Cie follow Henry Conners, tired of being in the witness protection program, to Las Vegas.

programme.title: Two Eyes for an Eye
programme.desc: Criminal joins forces with Chance.

programme.title: The Hot Potato Job
programme.desc: The team infiltrates a corrupt group involved in corporate agriculture to recover a stolen object.

programme.title: The Carnival Job
programme.desc: While the team infiltrates a high-tech home to steal a computer chip, the family's child is abducted from a carnival.

programme.title: The Grave Danger Job
programme.desc: The crew sets its sites on a funeral director who embezzles money from grieving patrons.

programme.title: The Boiler Room Job
programme.desc: The team goes up against a con man from a long lineage of greats.

programme.title: The Cross My Heart Job
programme.desc: The team tries to retrieve a stolen heart intended for a 15-year-old patient.

programme.title: The Queen's Gambit Job
programme.desc: Sterling convinces the team to steal a calibration weight for a nuclear reactor during an international chess tournament.

programme.title: The Experimental Job
programme.desc: The team must infiltrate the world of secret societies when homeless veterans in the Boston area begin to disappear.

programme.title: Ice Ca-Cabes
programme.desc: Team Scorpion is forced to freeze Cabe's body after he's seriously wounded by exploding shrapnel while on a mission in the desert.

programme.title: Faux Money Maux Problems
programme.desc: When Team Scorpion is tricked into producing counterfeit cash for a foreign entity that intends to ruin the U.S. economy, Paige relies on her mother's skills as a grifter to save them.

programme.title: The Hole Truth
programme.desc: Team Scorpion attempts to save a man stuck on the edge of a massive sinkhole that could permanently destroy the Los Angeles water supply.

programme.title: Sharknerdo
programme.desc: Team Scorpion's job to find sunken treasure goes awry when Walter and Paige's boat explodes, leaving them lost in the middle of the Pacific Ocean surrounded by sharks.

programme.title: Keep It in Check, Mate
programme.desc: Walter and Sylvester enter an international chess competition undercover on foreign soil in an effort to extricate a U.S. spy before her identity is exposed.

programme.title: Dirty Seeds, Done Dirt Cheap
programme.desc: Happy, Sylvester and Cabe suffer from life-threatening, fear-based hallucinations after a simple mission to protect a vital seed bank goes awry.

programme.title: Don't Burst My Bubble
programme.desc: Team Scorpion must move Happy's friend Ada, and the sterile bubble Ada lives in that protects her compromised immune system, to a secure location after a severe storm leaves the structure surrounded by dangerous debris.

programme.title: Monkey See, Monkey Poo
programme.desc: To stop a dangerous virus from spreading, Team Scorpion must locate an endangered monkey in the Amazon that has the antibody for the cure; Toby and Happy see a counselor to prepare for matrimony.

programme.title: Broken Wind
programme.desc: The team races to save Paige and Happy when a wire supporting the gondola they are in during a mission to repair a turbine at a wind farm snaps.

programme.title: Rock Block
programme.desc: The team defies the orders of a foreign government when it retrieves an asteroid containing DNA strands that could have deadly consequences if they are exposed.

programme.title: Strife on Mars
programme.desc: The team attempts to extract a pair of scientists trapped inside a failing and dangerous bio-dome designed for Mars.

programme.title: Go Home, Mr. French
programme.desc: Mr. French encounters an old friend at the park. Lorna, the nanny for a Duke & Duchess, is visiting in the states. When they are ready to return to England, Mr. French considers returning with her.

programme.title: The Award
programme.desc: Bill thinks the twins take advantage of him and French because they give in to their every wish. Bill says to deny the twins sometimes so they do not get spoiled.

programme.title: The Butler Method
programme.desc: A friend of Bill's is an actor who wants to shadow Mr. French in preparation for a movie role. Meanwhile, Cissy has trouble finding someone to ask to the Girls Tag Day Dance.

programme.title: I'd Tell You I Love You but We're Not Speaking
programme.desc: When all channels of communication break down between the Hubbards and Buells, a family-style group therapy session is conducted by Jerry's psychology professor.

programme.title: Herb's Little Helpers
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye turn Herb's office into a model of inefficiency when they take over for his sick secretary.

programme.title: Bye, Bye, Blackmailer
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye try diplomacy and artful deception to prevent a blow-up over Herb's $100 loan to Roger, which is due and which Roger can't repay.

programme.title: The Wig Story
programme.desc: Kaye borrows a blonde wig from Eve, and Roger's romantic reaction succeeds only in depressing Kaye, who's convinced that he now prefers blondes.

programme.title: It's Only Money
programme.desc: Tired of Roger's skinflint ways, Herb plots to play golf and gin rummy for money, but Herb finds himself in the financial hole when Roger's luck turns for the better.

programme.title: I Haven't Got a Secret
programme.desc: Kaye gets a game of charades under way to let everyone in on a secret that she isn't allowed to divulge: Roger's scripts are being considered for a TV series.

programme.title: Jerry's Night out with the Boys
programme.desc: The men side with Jerry's decision to play poker with the guys, so the women plan an all-girl night out for Suzie.

programme.title: The Long, Long Weekend
programme.desc: The Hubbards, Buells, and newlyweds each have secret plans for a weekend away from each other. But it backfires: They all head for the same mountain cabin, where snowstorm traps them together.

programme.title: Jealousy Makes the Heart Grow Fonder
programme.desc: Thanks to Kaye's overactive imagination, Eve suspects a rekindled romance between Herb and his old flame, who has come to visit.

programme.title: How Not to Manage a Rock Group
programme.desc: Jerry convinces his folks to put up $500 for a hippie rock group to make a demo recording. They scare off the band with talk of crew cuts, tuxedos, and old songs.

programme.title: Arthur, the Invisible Bear
programme.desc: Jody makes up an invisible friend, but it is a large bear.

programme.title: The Other Cheek
programme.desc: A young girl likes Jody, and shows her affection in the only way children know how - she picks on him and hits him.

programme.title: The Candy Striper
programme.desc: Bill thinks he will have a relaxing day, but then Jody wants help, Buffy needs to go to a Brownie meeting, and Cissy wants him to talk to the hospital staff about her being a candy striper.

programme.title: Fat, Fat, the Water Rat
programme.desc: Buffy goes to dance class but finds her teacher is not there. While waiting to be picked up, she meets some kids playing a game and joins them.

programme.title: The Toy Box
programme.desc: Bill falls over one of the twin's toys, and realizes they constantly have toys out which makes the place messy. Bill tells the twins that any toy left out will be taken away from them.

programme.title: Take Me out of the Ballgame
programme.desc: Jody and Buffy try out for the stick-ball team that plays on their street. Only one of the twins has skill and is accepted on the team.

programme.title: You Like Buffy Better
programme.desc: The twins compete for Uncle Bill's undivided attention. Each seems to think he likes the other twin better.

programme.title: Freddie
programme.desc: Bill wants to take Freddie out to dinner, but also has to go to the twins open house at school. Bill takes Freddie to the school, and she just loves it. She starts to think she wants to have kids.

programme.title: Our Friend Stanley
programme.desc: A new family moves into the apartment building where the Davis' live. Stanley is a child with a physical disability that hinders his walking. Buffy and Jody try to be friends with him at school.

programme.title: Somebody Upstairs
programme.desc: Someone new moves into the apartment building where the Davis' live, and it is a Broadway star. Buffy and Jody can't keep their eyes off her.

programme.title: Star Dust
programme.desc: Bill goes to a party where there are famous people. He meets Carol Haven, a movie star. She takes an interest in Bill and they start dating. He considers proposing marriage.

programme.title: Best of Breed
programme.desc: A dog follows Jody and Buffy home from school and they take it into the apartment. They hid the dog as long as they could until Mr. French finds the dog.

programme.title: Family Reunion
programme.desc: Aunt Fran invites them and Uncle Bill to Terre Haute for a family reunion. Once there, she wants the kids to live with her. She tells them Uncle Bill does not have time for kids.

programme.title: A Man's Place
programme.desc: Mr. French considers opening a restaurant after his date starts questioning his life as a gentleman's gentleman.

programme.title: The Great Kow-Tow
programme.desc: Bill entertains friends who are Japanese. The twins are interested by their culture. At the Japanese New Year celebration, the twins meet the grandfather and they tell him how fascinating he is.

programme.title: The Fish Watchers
programme.desc: Uncle Bill is working extra hours and the twins miss spending time with him. A co-worker suggests buying a fish tank and using that as a way to promote togetherness.

programme.title: The Day Nothing Happened
programme.desc: Bill is looking forward to a vacation, and Cissy is looking forward to her date with someone new. But the weather turns bad, and there is a blizzard. Everyone is kept at home.

programme.title: A House in the Country
programme.desc: Bill thinks living in the city is not good for the children, and considers moving to the country.

programme.title: A Matter of Tonsils
programme.desc: When Buffy has an operation to remove her tonsils, Jody complains of a sore throat, too. Uncle Bill and French think he's simply looking for attention until the doctor looks at them.

programme.title: A Member of the Family
programme.desc: Cissy is taking an art class and has been drawing caricature images of the family members, but not for Mr. French. He is hurt, however, Cissy has his picture and wants to surprise him with it.

programme.title: His and Hers
programme.desc: Uncle Bill & Mr. French attend Buffy & Jody's open night at school to view their latest art and work. At school, Bill meets another single parent with two young children and one teenager.

programme.title: The New Cissy
programme.desc: Cissy thinks the boys do not like her because there is something wrong with her, so Uncle Bill pays to have different people coach her in dress, makeup, talking, walking, and more.

programme.title: The Family Outing
programme.desc: Uncle Bill decides a weekend camping trip would be a great way for everyone to spend time together. Only two people enjoy the trip.

programme.title: Mr. French's Holiday
programme.desc: Mr. French takes a two-week vacation to the west with the others staying home. When Bill is called away to South America for work, the children end up flying out west to be with Mr. French.

programme.title: The Beasley Story
programme.desc: Jody and Buffy accidentally pull off the arm of Mrs. Beasley and it is a traumatic event.

programme.title: The Baby Sitters
programme.desc: Cissy agrees to babysit. Cissy gets a chance to go a concert, so she has a friend take her place. She gets sick, so her mother watches the kids, who then calls her husband...

programme.title: Family Portrait
programme.desc: Bill returns home from a business trip and finds that Cissy's hair style is different, Buffy has a new tooth, and he does not know who Jody's best friend is. Bill decides to become a full-time dad.

programme.title: The Latch Key Kid
programme.desc: Buffy wants more independence. Jody is allowed to go to some places on his own, but Buffy is not allowed the same privilege.

programme.title: By a Whisker
programme.desc: Jody wants to a club with the big boys, but they tell him he is too young. To prove he is old enough, they tell him he has to cut of some of Mr. French's whiskers and bring it to them.

programme.title: A Waltz from Vienna
programme.desc: A teenager from a royal family wants to marry Cissy, and she wants to marry him. She thinks she is a grown up who can make her own decisions, but Uncle Bill knows she just wants something different.

programme.title: Your Friend, Jody
programme.desc: A friend of Bill's confides that he is worried about his son growing up in a home with mostly females. That makes Bill wonder about Jody not having enough time with boys. Bill sends him off to camp.

programme.title: The Substitute Teacher
programme.desc: Jody and Buff's school teacher is out for a few days, and there is a substitute teacher. Jody develops a crush on her.

programme.title: Birds, Bees and Buffy
programme.desc: When a neighboring family has a baby, the children start to ask questions about where babies come from. Uncle Bill has to explain.

programme.title: First Love
programme.desc: Buffy is in love with Jody's friend, but he has eyes for Cissy.

programme.title: On Again, Off Again, Lohengrin
programme.desc: The bickering Hubbards and Buells are stunned when their kids return from a night out announcing they're engaged. After arguments about the wedding plans are finally settled.

programme.title: Everybody Goes on a Honeymoon
programme.desc: The Hubbards and the Buells show up at the same resort, and when their honeymooning kids unexpectedly arrive, rained out at their original destination, the in-laws spend a sleepless night together.

programme.title: All Fall Down
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye break their legs skiing and are bedridden in the same room.

programme.title: A Night to Forget
programme.desc: Going to a store to return a duplicate wedding gift for the kids, the mothers are unknowingly getting locked in the store when it closes.

programme.title: The Newlyweds Move In
programme.desc: Checking out the place that the kids have rented, the mothers return their deposit and fix up the Hubbards' garage apartment. Their snooping gets them caught hiding in the kids' shower.

programme.title: The Career Girls
programme.desc: To cut down on their wives' meddling, Herb and Roger suggest that they get jobs. Realizing that all their "suggesting, recommending, and advising" might just be too much, they decide to try it.

programme.title: Who's Afraid of Elizabeth Taylor?
programme.desc: When Roger and Herb admit that they would date Liz Taylor if given the chance, their wives console each other at the Buell house, leaving their befuddled husbands to go it alone next door.

programme.title: My Son, the Actor
programme.desc: Jerry decides to major in dramatic arts, giving everyone the showbiz bug. Suzie and all four parents tune up to help him audition for the school musical.

programme.title: How Do You Moonlight a Meatball?
programme.desc: When the kids in a financial bind, Eve and Kaye decide to help pay off Suzie's ring by selling Kaye's famous spaghetti and meatballs on the college campus.

programme.title: I Thought He'd Never Leave
programme.desc: A fugitive bank robber holds everyone at gunpoint at the Hubbards' home, whiling away the time playing gin rummy, and everyone hopes that Kaye's newly acquired karate skills will help.

programme.title: Oliver
programme.desc: Uncle Bill allows Buffy & Jody to have a friend stay over for a few days while the parents are out of town. But then Uncle Bill finds out the friend is a dog, and pets are not allowed in the building.

programme.title: Christmas Came a Little Early
programme.desc: Buffy makes friends with a girl in the building, and finds out the girl may not live too much longer. Buffy asks Uncle Bill to have a Christmas holiday because Eve might not be alive in December.

programme.title: The Unsound of Music
programme.desc: Buffy's class is practicing to perform in a singing program, but Buffy's voice is terrible. Uncle Bill hires a singing coach to help her.

programme.title: Albertine
programme.desc: Jody and Buffy make friends with a new girl at school whose father seems to always be out of town. Jody and Buffy find out the girl's father has really left the family and may never return.

programme.title: A Matter of Choice
programme.desc: Uncle Bill feels that Buffy and Jody would benefit from listening to fairy tales than watching war-based programs on TV, but the fairy tales end up giving them nightmares.

programme.title: Ciao, Uncle Bill
programme.desc: While on a job in Rome, Bill falls in love with a much younger woman whom he plans to marry, until learning that she has no desire to share his life with Cissy, Buffy, and Jody.

programme.title: A Nanny for All Seasons
programme.desc: After Mr. French is ribbed by his gentlemen peers about also being a nanny, he resigns himself to return to his role as a gentlemen's gentleman and starts to shun the children.

programme.title: Family Plan
programme.desc: Bill breaks his leg skiing and Buffy, Jody, and Cissy give up their free time to take care of him. Bill's girlfriend also wants to help him, but he realizes the children care much more than she does.

programme.title: To Love with Buffy
programme.desc: Buffy is delighted to go with Uncle Bill to Puerto Rico because she gets to have his full attention. However, Bill meets a former girlfriend and it seems like he may divide his time between the two.

programme.title: A Family Group
programme.desc: Cissy is excited to have her friend over, who she envies for her glamorous lifestyle, until her friend reveals that her parents are separated and all she wants is a loving family like Cissy has.

programme.title: A Lesson for Grown-Ups
programme.desc: The kids overhear Bill talking about one of his bridge's collapsing. He goes to the construction site to help. The kids think they are going to lose all their money to help pay for the bridge.

programme.title: Oh, to Be in England
programme.desc: Bill gets a job in England which seems like it might last a year. Everyone plans to move, but then it seems like Bill won't be able to go.

programme.title: A Matter of Privacy
programme.desc: The twins start using a tape recorder to record conversations other people have in private.

programme.title: Lost in Spain: Part 1
programme.desc: Uncle Bill takes everyone on vacation to Spain. As they start the great vacation, Mr French and the twins get separated. Bill and Cissy join Mr. French in the search for Buffy and Jody.

programme.title: Lost in Spain: Part 2
programme.desc: Bill, Cissy and Mr. French continue to search for Buffy and Jody in Spain. Meanwhile, the twins are being cared for at a school house run by nuns.

programme.title: Lost in Spain: Part 3
programme.desc: The twins are finally found and reunited with their family.

programme.title: A Diller, a Dollar
programme.desc: Buffy likes a boy at school. She starts purposely failing her classes so she does not seem smarter than him. The school thinks Buffy is able to skip a grade but she does not want to skip.

programme.title: The Young Man from Bolivia
programme.desc: Jody has been exchanging letters with a pen-pal from Bolivia. Finally, the boy gets a chance to visit Jody in New York. When he arrives, everyone is more interested in him than Jody.

programme.title: Speak for Yourself, Mr. French
programme.desc: Mr. French has a new admirer. She is an attractive young secretary, and she is determined to spend time with Mr. French. He starts falling for her, but soon realizes her ultimate goal is Bill.

programme.title: The Flip Side
programme.desc: Cissy falls for a popular musician who writes songs about her. Love-struck Cissy decides to surprise him by going to the concert. She is the one surprised when he starts singing to another woman.

programme.title: The Matter of Dignity
programme.desc: Mr. French is accused of sending questionable letters to a young woman. He and Bill take a stint as a detective to find the source.

programme.title: Flower Power
programme.desc: Cissy meets some flower children in the park and wants to be one of them. Uncle Bill is none too pleased.

programme.title: My Man, the Star
programme.desc: Movie producer Fred Wallace spots Mr. French in the park and thinks he would be perfect for his new production. French flatly declines. After some convincing by his family, he agrees to do it.

programme.title: No Uncle Is an Island
programme.desc: Mr. French, Cissy, Buffy and Jody decide to give Bill some time alone for the weekend. Unfortunately, while they are away, a barrage of neighbors stop by, disrupting Bill's relaxation, peace and quiet.

programme.title: The Wings of an Angel
programme.desc: A former friend of Bill's visits, asking for a favor. Harv has just gotten out of prison and needs a job. The twins are afraid of him , and Cissy thinks she can help him adjust.

programme.title: Uncle Prince Charming
programme.desc: One of Cissy's friends has a crush on Uncle Bill, and he cannot shake her from this feeling.

programme.title: Cissy's Apartment
programme.desc: Cissy decides it is time to move out on her own, so she moves into an apartment with a friend. It seems like she hasn't left home when when her family constantly visits her.

programme.title: The Jody Affair
programme.desc: When playing at school, a ball thrown breaks a window and Jody is blamed. Jody denies doing it.

programme.title: With This Ring
programme.desc: Since most of Cissy's friends are getting engaged and married, Cissy decides it it is time for her and Gregg to be engaged, even if Gregg does not want it.

programme.title: What's Funny about a Broken Leg?
programme.desc: Buffy breaks her leg while playing with friends. When Uncle Bill tells her she will not be able to go to the circus, she is sad. Uncle Bill saves the day by bringing the circus act to the building.

programme.title: The Birthday Boy
programme.desc: When the twins find out that Mr French's birthday is approaching, they ask Cissy to help them set up a birthday party for Mr French.

programme.title: When Fates Collide
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) becomes the Empress of Rome with no memory of her past when Caesar (Karl Urban) chains up the three Fates and cuts the strands of time to alter his destiny.

programme.title: Many Happy Returns
programme.desc: On their way to deliver the Helmet of Hermes to Thebes, Xena (Lucy Lawless) and Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) save the young virgin Genia (Katie Stuart) from being sacrificed by religious zealots.

programme.title: Soul Possession
programme.desc: When an ancient scroll chronicling the life of Xena surfaces in the present, conflicts arise among the modern-day reincarnations of Xena (Lucy Lawless), Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor), Ares (Kevin Smith) and Joxer (Ted Raimi).

programme.title: Friend in Need, Part 1
programme.desc: Summoned by a long-lost spiritual soulmate, Xena (Lucy Lawless) heads for Japan with Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) on a daunting mission to save the city of Higuchi from destruction and make amends for her past.

programme.title: Friend in Need, Part 2
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) and Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) face the greatest threat they've ever known when they go up against the evil Yodoshi (Adrian Brown) and an army of 20,000 elite Samurai warriors.

programme.title: Sins of the Past
programme.desc: Xena atones for her evil past by defending her home village from the marauding warlord Draco.

programme.title: Chariots of War
programme.desc: Xena defends a town against a band of thugs led by a father and son duo.

programme.title: Dreamworker
programme.desc: When Gabrielle is kidnapped by a mystic, Xena enters an altered state of consciousness and must face ghosts from her past in order to rescue her friend.

programme.title: Cradle of Hope
programme.desc: Xena employs stealthy maneuvers to protect an infant who an oracle claims will one day usurp a king's throne.

programme.title: The Path Not Taken
programme.desc: Xena helps a prince rescue his fiancee who has been kidnapped by a greedy arms dealer opposed to their marriage.

programme.title: The Reckoning
programme.desc: Ares (Kevin Smith), the god of war, frames Xena (Lucy Lawless) for murder with the hope she will turn to him in desperation and become his evil ally. With Renee O'Connor.

programme.title: The Titans
programme.desc: When Gabrielle unknowingly utters a chant that releases three imprisoned Titans, Xena must figure out how to save innocent villagers.

programme.title: Prometheus
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle team up with Hercules and Iolaus to free the kidnapped Prometheus, the god responsible for making fire available to Earth.

programme.title: Death in Chains
programme.desc: When King Sisyphus captures Hades' sister Celesta, Xena and Gabrielle must free her before mankind is doomed to eternal suffering.

programme.title: Hooves and Harlots
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle try to prevent a war between the Amazons and the Centaurs by determining who killed an Amazon princess.

programme.title: The Black Wolf
programme.desc: Xena comes to the aid of imprisoned freedom fighters who refuse to reveal the identity of their mysterious leader.

programme.title: Beware Greeks Bearing Gifts
programme.desc: Xena joins the climactic battle between the warring Greeks and Trojans that is precipitated by the false peace offering of the Trojan horse.

programme.title: Athens City Academy of the Performing Bards
programme.desc: Gabrielle cons her way into a prestigious storytelling competition and ends up helping a fellow bard who is under pressure from his father to win.

programme.title: A Fistful of Dinars
programme.desc: A hidden key to a chamber containing Ambrosia, which turns mortals into gods, will fall into the wrong hands if Xena does not find it first.

programme.title: Warrior...princess
programme.desc: Xena trades identities with a look-alike princess in order to defeat the young woman's would-be assassins. Features Lucy Lawless in a dual role.

programme.title: Mortal Beloved
programme.desc: Xena crosses the river Styx to the Underworld to help her deceased lover stop a madman from destroying the heavenly Elysian Fields.

programme.title: The Royal Couple of Thieves
programme.desc: Xena forces a renowned thief to assist her in an elaborate scheme to recover a powerful weapon from a warlord.

programme.title: The Prodigal
programme.desc: Gabrielle takes on the role of leader when she returns home and finds her village ill-prepared to defend itself from a band of marauders.

programme.title: Altared States
programme.desc: A boy will die in a sacrificial killing unless Xena can stop his jealous older brother.

programme.title: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: As the god Ares schemes to make Xena lead his army, the warrior princess meets a man claiming to be her long-lost father.

programme.title: The Greater Good
programme.desc: Gabrielle assumes Xena's identity after the warrior princess is injured during a skirmish with a warlord bent on destroying Salmoneus.

programme.title: Callisto
programme.desc: The female warrior Callisto tries to turn the world against Xena by committing acts of terrorism in her name.

programme.title: Death Mask
programme.desc: After learning a raiding party's leader was responsible for the destruction in their village, Xena and her brother set out to destroy him.

programme.title: Is There A Doctor in the House?
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle run a makeshift hospital for war casualties and attempt to convince a general that the bloody conflict should end.

programme.title: Orphan of War
programme.desc: Xena's deepest secret is revealed when she and Gabrielle join forces with the Centaurs to battle the evil warlord, Dagnine (Mark Ferguson).

programme.title: Remember Nothing
programme.desc: The three Fates give Xena the chance to recreate her life when she agrees to give up her warrior ways.

programme.title: The Giant Killer
programme.desc: Xena must face her old friend Goliath (Todd Rippon) in battle when the giant refuses to turn his back on the ruthless Philistines.

programme.title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle join forces with Joxer (Ted Raimi) and Orpheus (Matthew Chamberlain) to defeat the evil god Bacchus (Anthony Ray Parker), who is transforming innocent girls into deadly monsters.

programme.title: The Return of Callisto
programme.desc: When the fierce woman warrior Callisto (Hudson Leick) escapes from prison, Xena must face her in battle once again.

programme.title: Warrior..Princess..Tramp
programme.desc: Xena must foil an attempt to dethrone her friend and look-alike, Princess Diana, by the unscrupulous Meg, who bears a startling resemblance to both.

programme.title: Intimate Stranger
programme.desc: With the help of Ares (Kevin Smith) in the Underworld, Callisto (Hudson Leick) switches bodies with Xena and returns to the land of the living where the two women warriors battle once more, this time disguised as each other.

programme.title: Ten Little Warlords
programme.desc: While still trapped in the body of her enemy, Callisto, Xena is forced to enter a competition where warlords vie to become the new god of war.

programme.title: The Wild Angels
