programme.title: Secret Weapons of the Third Reich
programme.desc: They were weapons systems that were far beyond anything the Allies had or could have imagined in World War II.

programme.title: Hitler's Henchmen
programme.desc: Hitler's disturbed henchmen, driven by loyalty, committed atrocities, hiding genocide behind propaganda.

programme.title: 19 Years in Vietnam: Beans, Bullets and Bandaids
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was a costly conflict requiring strategic logistics to supply soldiers with essentials like "beans, bullets, and bandaids."

programme.title: The Battle Above: True Stories from WWII Pilots
programme.desc: Experience real accounts from WWII pilots as they share harrowing stories from aerial combat, revealing truths more powerful than fiction.

programme.title: Nazis on Trial: Nuremberg in Colour
programme.desc: In 1945, Nuremberg becomes the site of justice as the Allies establish a tribunal to prosecute Nazi war crimes and dictatorship atrocities.

programme.title: Military Mayhem In Vietnam III
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was a long, costly conflict between North Vietnam and South Vietnam, allied with the U.S. The Vietcong used jungle cover for guerrilla warfare against inexperienced American soldiers. It was a 360-degree war with attacks from all angles, where territory changed hands regularly and political loyalties were often unclear.

programme.title: Vietnam War: Tales from Nam
programme.desc: This documentary offers an intimate look at the Vietnam War, a relentless conflict from 1955 to 1975.

programme.title: War In Russia: The Siege of Leningrad
programme.desc: The siege of Leningrad began on 8 September 1941, lasting 872 days. It was one of the most destructive sieges, marked by massive casualties and systematic starvation.

programme.title: Hitler's Defeat: Victory Against All Odds
programme.desc: The British people's courage and 'Keep Calm and Carry On' attitude led to victory against Hitler. Women took on essential war work, facing evacuation, bombings, and the absence of men at war.

programme.title: As It Happened: Tarawa
programme.desc: Tarawa, a heavily defended island, saw Marines face a fierce battle in 1943, shaping the Pacific War.

programme.title: Aerial Assault Vietnam
programme.desc: Decades after it ended, the Vietnam War might seem like a distant memory. It was the longest war in American history and the only one from which the USA did not emerge victorious. A greater tonnage of bombs was dropped than in WWII. The war saw helicopters come into their own, transporting troops and supporting air power. For every pilot, there were dozens of support staff. The aerial bombardment of Vietnam remains one of the most staggering sustained attacks in history.

programme.title: The Battle Above: True Stories from WWII Pilots
programme.desc: Experience real accounts from WWII pilots as they share harrowing stories from aerial combat, revealing truths more powerful than fiction.

programme.title: As It Happened: Pearl Harbour
programme.desc: Reconstructing the 1941 Pearl Harbour attack with aerial photos and firsthand accounts, this film offers a unique view.

programme.title: Victory at Last: WWII is Over
programme.desc: Germany's defeat led to celebrations in the UK and North America. In London, crowds gathered at Buckingham Palace, where King George VI, Queen Elizabeth, and Winston Churchill appeared.

programme.title: Field of Operations: The U-Boats
programme.desc: Explore the perilous WWII naval warfare between German U-Boats and Allied forces, with over 100,000 lives lost.

programme.title: Mao's Secrets
programme.desc: The roots of China's conflict with Taiwan date back to the Second World War.

programme.title: Sitzkrieg: The Phony War
programme.desc: Hitler's lightning strike in Poland soon gave way to a strange eight month waiting game.

programme.title: The Battle of Britain
programme.desc: The men and women who made victory possible in the Battle of Britain.

programme.title: Weapons of the Shadow War
programme.desc: An investigation into the instruments of sabotage and clandestine operations used in war.

programme.title: The French Resistance
programme.desc: Nazi Germanys invasion of France inflicted humiliation on the French.

programme.title: Vietnam: Johnson's Battleground
programme.desc: Looking at the war behind the war in Vietnam and the critical struggle over public opinion; secret Vietnamese strategies were designed to sabotage American morale, while Lyndon Johnson's White House attempted to keep the support of U.S. citizens.

programme.title: 1933: The Fall of the Weimar Republic
programme.desc: The Weimar Republic comes to bear for many the humiliation of World War I and the blame for all its hardships; issues such as hyperinflation and the Great Depression drive many Germans into the arms of radical and extremist political parties.

programme.title: Hitler's Fatal Mistake: The Fall of the Third Reich
programme.desc: With the declaration of war, Hitler's break with Stalin was a fatal mistake, leading to the Third Reich's fall.

programme.title: Nazi Manhunt
programme.desc: The war is over, and the atrocities have been discovered. Thousands of Nazi officers attempt to flee the country, heading towards South America, believing they will find sympathy and evade justice. The allied forces, Britain, France, the United States, and Russia, all agreed to prosecute any living Nazi party officials for the crimes they had committed.

programme.title: Field of Operations: D-Day
programme.desc: On June 6, 1944, the Normandy landings, known as D-Day, began the Allied invasion of Normandy, marking a pivotal point in WWII.

programme.title: As It Happened: Guadalcanal
programme.desc: US Marines' first Pacific War attack leads to a six-month battle against the Japanese, captured through lost photos and footage.

programme.title: Surviving Hitler's Mad Doctors
programme.desc: The Nazi Regime imposed some of the most insane form of eugenics the world has seen. Between 1939 and 1945, at least 70 medical projects, involving cruel and lethal experimentation on human subjects, were conducted in concentration camps.

programme.title: The Korean War: No Longer Forgotten Part I
programme.desc: The Korean War, underestimated yet impactful, forced rapid military advancements amid a fierce ideological battle.

programme.title: Guadalcanal: Invasion in the Pacific
programme.desc: In 1942, the Battle of Guadalcanal was a key Allied victory, halting Japanese expansion in the Pacific.

programme.title: 19 Years in Vietnam: Beans, Bullets and Bandaids
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was a costly conflict requiring strategic logistics to supply soldiers with essentials like "beans, bullets, and bandaids."

programme.title: The Verdict
programme.desc: A duty-conscious corrections officer falls for a younger inmate, helps him escape, leading to a search and media frenzy.

programme.title: News of War: 1943
programme.desc: Military camera operators capture the raw reality of World War II, revealing heroic victories, battles, and daily life.

programme.title: Field of Operations: The War in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: On June 10, 1940, Mussolini declared war on France and Britain, leading to battles in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: As It Happened: Saipan
programme.desc: In June 1944, US forces landed on Saipan, marking their first step on Japanese soil. The battle was brutal, lasting three weeks. Reconnaissance photos and firsthand accounts provide unique insights.

programme.title: Flying Fortress: History of the B-17 Bomber
programme.desc: The B-17, known as the flying fortress, symbolizes U.S. air power. This film explores its history and impact.

programme.title: Ukraine 2022: Attack on Freedom
programme.desc: Russia's invasion of Ukraine on February 24th, 2022, shocked the world. Despite Putin's claims, Ukraine's spirit endures. President Zelenskyy inspired resilience, and sanctions were imposed on Russia.

programme.title: War at Sea: Naval Aviation
programme.desc: The idea of uniting the aircraft and the ship is a simple one but this simple idea has been the subject of great technical innovation, has lead to decisive military success and has found itself the focus of increasing controversy.

programme.title: The Fall
programme.desc: A duty-conscious corrections officer falls for a younger inmate, helps him escape, leading to a search and media frenzy.

programme.title: Korea: Stalin's Secret Air War
programme.desc: An examination of the early years of the Cold War, when Americans sparred with Soviet pilots over the Yalu River.

programme.title: Gulf War: Iraq's Secrets
programme.desc: A look at Saddam Hussein's deception to make friendships with the West, but by invading Kuwait, he turned his back on those alliances forever.

programme.title: Hirohito's War
programme.desc: Japanese tradition made him a god, but Japanese law made him Commander in Chief of the Japanese Armed Forces.

programme.title: Israeli Intelligence
programme.desc: In a constant war of survival, the state of Israel commissioned super sleuths for military intelligence, kidnappings, and hostage rescues.

programme.title: WWI: Germany's Secret Gambles
programme.desc: As the armies of World War One struggled, the German government turned to covert operations to break the stalemate.

programme.title: Vietnam: Special Operations
programme.desc: As American units fought under rules of engagement imposed by their political leaders, unconventional Special Forces fought classified battles.

programme.title: Dirt Track Small Block
programme.desc: We team up with UNOH to build a brand-new engine for their racing program. A new car class with new engine rules makes for an educational build experience that pays off on the racetrack.

programme.title: Final 48 Hour Fixes
programme.desc: It's the final weekend push that Brian and Jason have to upgrade their 2011 Lexus IS 250, Project Budget Baller. They've only got 48 hours to install a new head unit, better speakers, and gloss black wheel and tires. Will they finish on time?

programme.title: Diagnosing Problems On A Caprice Wagon To Get It Up And Running
programme.desc: We found an old Caprice wagon and diagnosed some problems to get it back on the road. After getting it running, we head to the hills of Kentucky for the Pineville Hill Climb, a grassroots racing event that adds some local flair.

programme.title: Pit Pass at a NHRA Race Weekend
programme.desc: Meet the graduates of SAMTech who have found a home in NHRA racing.

programme.title: The Beach Cruiser Bronco Gets Its Colors
programme.desc: We welcome legendary custom car builder Chris Ryan and his team to help with our 1974 Bronco. We give it a professional paint job that will completely transform this build.

programme.title: Add an Extra 100HP to a Ford Windsor
programme.desc: More hi-po how-to for an extra 100 horsepower out of 408 Windsor Stroker. Plus, Engine Power attends the MATCO Tool Expo.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 8 - Power Moves
programme.desc: Wired and inspired - The guys enter the winding maze of wiring as they install a new ECU. Then, it's out with the old and in with the new as Joel upgrades the sound deadening and Tommy puts a new shine on the original taillights.

programme.title: Tension Prevention With New Suspension For The '71 Caprice -Fat Stack Part 3
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel visit the powder room to freshen up the frame on Fat Stack, a 1971 Chevy Caprice, while upgrading their suspension in disbelief.

programme.title: Triple Threat Exhaust
programme.desc: Our split-bumper Camaro receives a hand-crafted exhaust, designed by one of Magnaflow's own.

programme.title: Test Sled Reincarnated Stage 2
programme.desc: Our Test Sled has been rejuvenated with a new engine & transmission. Now we'll turn some wrenches to make brake and safety upgrades so we can test it on the chassis dyno and at the race track.

programme.title: Chassis Dyno Mania
programme.desc: We put our past engine builds to the test now that they have been installed in awesome hot rods! From the Gen III Hemi of Detroit Muscle's "Road Burner" to the 496ci Big Block Chevy of Music City Trucks' "Faux Guy", we put the power down to the wheels and get final wheel horsepower numbers.

programme.title: Solid Roller 318 LA
programme.desc: Our 318 Mopar is back AGAIN, so we can take it to the next level! This already stout small block gets a solid roller camshaft and a single plane intake to crank up the RPM and turn up the horsepower.

programme.title: Running Our '69 Camaro Through the Wringer
programme.desc: With the SeaFoam Camaro finished up, it is time to see what all those upgrades have done for our Restomod Giveaway. Then we help a viewer with some repairs on their vehicle on another Driveway Rescue

programme.title: The Faux Guy: The Series Premiere
programme.desc: We lay out our plan to rebuild our 1985 Chevy K-10. We start by tearing it down and building it back up with new sheet metal repair. What we have in mind for this truck will make you do a double-take!

programme.title: Nissan Trailgater Part 1
programme.desc: We're stepping out of our comfort zone and building the ultimate dual-purpose pickup, a 2025 Nissan Frontier that we've nicknamed Trailgater. Eric and Joel modify a brand-new Nissan and turn it into the ultimate tailgating truck that would make any sports fan or overlander envious and excited.

programme.title: Junkyard Ford 445 FE Gets Modern EFI
programme.desc: Our 445 FE is back, a modern EFI system, along with a time-tested tunnel wedge intake made for drivability.

programme.title: '65 C10 Rewind 1
programme.desc: Project Lo 'n Slo is what we called our '65 Fleetside Chevy C10. With a beautiful patina, we leave the body to mother nature, but ditch the 350 small block for a unique 292 straight-six with a turbo.

programme.title: Keeping a Coyote V8 Cool On a Ford Ranger Prerunner
programme.desc: The Prerunner Ranger's rollcage gets more tube work fabrication plus, we pick up a Tacoma for a new off-road project.

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger Suspension Mods and Fiberglass Panels
programme.desc: Jeremy and Eliza finish up mounting the adjustable shocks add the Raptor-like fiberglass skin to the Prerunner Ranger.

programme.title: Tearing Down and Rebuilding a Kingpin Dana 60 Axle
programme.desc: It's fabrication time on our Chevy Suburban we're calling "Unbreakable", and with the help of Jeremy and Jimmy from Carcass the guys build an off-road-ready frame that's out of this world.

programme.title: The FJ60 Makeover Begins
programme.desc: A new project rolls into the shop-our 1987 FJ60 Land Cruiser, and the plan is simple: turn it into an affordable resto-mod daily driver with modern power, suspension, and comfort upgrades. First, we look back at how it drives now and break down the game plan. Then it's teardown time, followed by getting the axles ready for what's coming next: a refreshed third member with updated gears and lockers, plus full axle rebuilds-knuckles, inners, outers, and new brakes.

programme.title: Better Breathing for our Big Block Ford
programme.desc: Our 460 Big Block Ford is back for its final iteration, where we upgrade it with a weight saving, better flowing induction. We're looking to up the naturally aspirated horsepower before this beast finds its new home. As always, we'll test our improvement on the Engine Dyno.

programme.title: 427ci LSx Part 1
programme.desc: We kick off a brand new, ground up build for a Music City Trucks project, featuring a scratch built 427ci pump gas LSx. With awesome hot rod power and durability in mind, we start with a new Summit Racing Pro LS block and prep this beast for serious short-bed C10 service.

programme.title: First Gen Bronco Gets a Modern Suspension
programme.desc: Our '74 Bronco build is getting a suspension overhaul plus new axles, brakes, wheels and tires! And John Kramen from Mecum Auctions stops by to check on the progress.

programme.title: Pro LS on the Dyno
programme.desc: We complete our stroker LS powerplant and put it to the ultimate performance test in the dyno cell!

programme.title: Building An Exhaust To Fit The Abandoned Chevy Silverado's 5.3L LS - Part 3
programme.desc: We continue to work on our abandoned '96 Chevy Silverado truck, buttoning up underneath the hood with cooling and power steering installations. Plus we build a custom exhaust for our freshened up 5.3 liter engine.

programme.title: Sleeving a 396 Big Block for a 1970 Camaro
programme.desc: The car has to be converted from automatic to manual floor pedals, and the firewall gets some factory style mods that change the car over to big-block style. Then, everything you ever wanted to know about brake lines and fuel lines.

programme.title: Road Course Camaro Part 8 Rear Axle and Brake Mockup
programme.desc: Our rear axle needs new mounting points for our shocks to bolt to our '72 Camaro, so we fabricate new brackets. We also mock-up our rear brake setup to our axle before giving it a fresh coat of paint.

programme.title: Repairing An Abandoned Chevy Silverado - Part 1
programme.desc: The Carcass crew gives you some tips on how to repair rusty trouble spots and remove dents on your project. Then we'll walk you through getting it ready for primer.

programme.title: '71 Chevy Caprice Gets Perfectly Polished Chrome
programme.desc: Chrome is where the heart is - Tommy and Joel update the bright work on their '71 Chevy Caprice and they'll visit the chrome plater to break down how the new bling comes into being.

programme.title: Baja Style Bug Is Ready to Take Flight
programme.desc: Jeremy and Jimmy take a left for dead VW Beetle, and a roughed up Can-Am creating a baja style bug that will take flight.

programme.title: Putting TrackHawk Power Into A 1986 Jeep Wagoneer
programme.desc: The guys visit DBR Performance and their first chance ever to drive a Jeep TrackHawk, which inspires a plan of their own...to turn an old Wagoneer into a screaming street monster.

programme.title: New Suspension Turns 2012 Jeep JK Into Dual-Purpose 4x4
programme.desc: The Carcass crew found a 2012 Jeep JK at an auction and just had to buy it. They'll tear into it and start adding some off-road suspension components, turning it into a dual-purpose wheeler that can handle some serious trails.

programme.title: The Perfect Fit For The '71 Chevy Caprice Body Panels
programme.desc: A touch of glass - We begin to piece our '71 Caprice Fat Stack back together, installing the front and rear glass as well as the hood, deck lid, and body panels showing you some how-to-hints for favorable fitment.

programme.title: 632ci EFI BBC Part 2
programme.desc: The guys in Engine Power are back on their 632ci Big Block Chevy project as they get it wrapped up and ready for the dyno! Picking up with a forged shortblock, they will continue to revamp the large displacement engine into a street slaying beast with high flowing heads set up for the new hydraulic roller cam, bulletproof valvetrain, a beautiful accessory drive, and a swap-ready standalone EFI system.

programme.title: 427 cubic inches of Naturally Aspirated HP for Javelin Trans Am Tribute Build
programme.desc: A 427 ci LSX engine goes naturally aspirated for an underappreciated muscle car.

programme.title: Supercharged Coyote
programme.desc: The students at SAM TECH build a supercharged Coyote engine to compete at the drag strip.

programme.title: Horsepower, Brakes, and Tone for a Rare 2014 CTS-V Wagon
programme.desc: Can the Blacktop Speed Shop crew turn this rare 2014 Cadillac CTS-V Wagon from a 1 of 400 ever made into a 1 of 1 unicorn for the EBC Brakes' booth at SEMA?

programme.title: Our 1960s Jeep is a Rust Bucket
programme.desc: Project Spartan is back and it's... worse than we thought. With a little help from Eric, Chris gets hard at work on this 1969 M715 Kaizer Jeep and the truly insane levels of rust in the cab. You've never seen a truck this bad before. Stay tuned.

programme.title: Dropping A Legendary Mondello 455 Big Block Into The Retro Hurst Olds - Part 3
programme.desc: Grease and gears begin to fly as we swap out our '83 Hurst-Olds' measly 307 engine for one built in the Horsepower shop with the help of legendary engine builder Joe Mondello. This big block is truly one-of-a-kind.

programme.title: Hear That Hemi: Bringing A 1970 Hemi Cuda Back To Life
programme.desc: HEMI Cuda', need we say more? The Detroit Muscle crew tune up a rare 1970 HEMI Barracuda for its busy owner. We wake the elephant sleeping under the hood, and take joy ride!

programme.title: Power Source - Project UnSanctioned Part 2
programme.desc: The Carcass guys pick up the power plant for their grassroots racer and start assembling the heart of the beast with power producing components.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 3 - Yard Time
programme.desc: Our 1969 Pontiac GTO, Project Henchman, needs to bulk up before breaking out, so Tommy and Peyton are using the time to modify the chassis and install new fuel lines on this tough prisoner.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle Gets a History Lesson at the Henry Ford Museum
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc take us on an automotive history lesson at the largest indoor-outdoor museum complex in the U.S., the Henry Ford Museum in Dearborn Michigan.

programme.title: Modding a Mustang GT for an Aggressive Look
programme.desc: We add a body kit and a wrap to our EBC Brakes giveaway Mustang plus, Tommy and Marc bring back the Hellcat '69 Charger.

programme.title: High Tech Slant Six
programme.desc: Before we give our Slant Six a much-needed power boost, we'll reinforce the engine internals with a fully-forged rotating assembly.

programme.title: Crushing It: Episode 3
programme.desc: Driving a monster truck isn't easy, but Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live host, Tommy Kane, shows you how, when he gets behind the wheel of a legendary monster truck. Don't miss the action and the behind the scenes look of our Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live trucks!

programme.title: Prerunner Protection, Skidplate, Lights, and More
programme.desc: The Prerunner Ranger gets desert protection, lights and wiring toward ignition.

programme.title: Jeep JL Clearance Time
programme.desc: It's clearance time in XOR! The Jeep JL is getting ready for their upcoming Off Road Adventure with new custom-built fenders and a MagnaFlow exhaust.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 4 - Prison Tats
programme.desc: Project Henchman is hoping to get a new look on this episode of Detroit Muscle. Tommy and Peyton begin rust repair and a new paint job that'll make this '69 Pontiac GTO shine.

programme.title: '69 Camaro Gets a Fresh Interior Look with Overhauled Seats and Carpet
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc finish up the last few details on our '69 SeaFoam Camaro. Plus a mechanics fantasy land we head to California for the Matco Tools Expo to see what new products they have coming out.

programme.title: Ford F-100 Down to the Wire
programme.desc: Inching ever closer to putting Clint Black's Ford F-100 project to bed, Eric and Joel scrap all the old wood, refresh some essentials, and wire the engine to fire.

programme.title: Turbocharged Ford 300 Flatbed Dynoed
programme.desc: We plumb the turbocharger in our 1964 Ford Flatbed truck. We'll also install the fuel and cooling systems. After a tune-up we'll head to the Engine Power shop and test our work on their chassis dyno.

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger's Final Hours
programme.desc: Our Ford PrerunnerRanger is in its final hours. The rear axle is going in its final location, and we're making a few aesthetic changes out front.

programme.title: Building a Loaded 5.3L LS
programme.desc: Our 5.3L street machine powerplant gets updated with sequential EFI and more.

programme.title: Will There Be A Big Power Difference On A Mildly Modded AMC 258 Straight 6?
programme.desc: What started as a simple "aerosol overhaul" for a Postal Jeep's powerplant gets a little more complicated!

programme.title: Turbo Tech Making 1200+ Horsepower
programme.desc: Turbo pioneer, Kenny Duttweiler steps in to lend a hand with our LME 427 ci LSX engine. Boosting this bullet with a high-tech turbo system produces a lot of excitement and big dyno numbers!

programme.title: 632 ci Big Block Chevy Build for Project Wild & Willys
programme.desc: A high-compression 632 ci Big Block Chevy provides massive power for XOR's Willys Wagon.

programme.title: Memorial
programme.desc: We help out our friends in Engine Power with fabricated fenders for their new test sled, and we go on a Driveway Rescue that helps build a memorial for a fallen soldier.

programme.title: Ultimate 318 LA: Part 1
programme.desc: We pull a 318 LA straight from the junkyard and put it on the Dyno to see what this over 40-year-old Mopar can make. Then we tear into it to upgrade the parts holding it back on power and get it prepped to become a righteous street monster.

programme.title: 496ci Stroker Big Block Chevy
programme.desc: We put some custom touches on our 496ci Stroker Big Block Chevy and get it ready for the street rod life!

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 10: Cool and Comfortable
programme.desc: Our 1972 C-10 is in the shop for a comfort upgrade. We're installing a modern HVAC system, adding heat and sound dampening, and sharing a few wiring tips to keep Cream Puff running cool and smooth.

programme.title: Sierra HD Duramax Allison Transmission
programme.desc: We'll show you the step-by-step inner workings of an Allison transmission when our guys build the gearbox for a Sierra HD Duramax.

programme.title: Building a 4-Link Suspension to Conquer the Trails
programme.desc: Our '78 Postal Jeep gets an upgraded suspension that can handle the trails. We'll start by fabricating our axles and frame for a 4 link setup.

programme.title: Burnt Junkyard 6.4L Gen III HEMI Rises From The Ashes
programme.desc: A burned-up 6.4L Gen III HEMI is revived with some old school hot rod parts.

programme.title: Turbocharged Ford 300 Inline Six Makes Over 500 HP on the Dyno
programme.desc: Ford's inline six industrial engine gets what you've been asking for...a turbo!

programme.title: Pre-Runner Ranger Part 1
programme.desc: We're getting the rear racing suspension installed in our 2002 Ford Ranger!

programme.title: Valvoline Camaro Part 2
programme.desc: 'The Valvoline Sweepstakes Camaro is completed and readied to be given to a lucky viewer.

programme.title: Building a Baja Style Bug With a VW Beetle and A Stock Can-Am Maverick X3
programme.desc: What do you get when you combine a Bug and a UTV? The answer: BajAwesome. The Carcass team builds a baja style bug with a left for dead VW Beetle and a stock Can-Am Maverick X3. This is part 1 of a 3 part BajAwesome build.

programme.title: C10 Teardown and K1500 Goes Rally Racing
programme.desc: LT and Austin start the teardown process and make some upgrade decisions for Project Lo 'n Slo.

programme.title: Artistry In Motion - Project UnSanctioned Part 5
programme.desc: Our 2001 BMW race car, Project Unsanctioned, heads to the paint booth to paint the roll cage. Then we'll head back into the shop for a stylistic wrap and some artistic freedom, before finally assembly and taking it to the track.

programme.title: How to Build a High Power Diesel Beast
programme.desc: Modifying a Duramax to make high power starts with a teardown and some machining before the new performance parts are added. Plus Austin mods up the body for a cool clean look.

programme.title: Tune & Tone
programme.desc: Is custom exhaust worth it on a budget build? The age-old question - does tone matter when dollars do? Will our custom exhaust take our Lexus IS250 up a notch, or will we have to cut back to finish our build.

programme.title: Fabricating an Aggressive Rear Spoiler for a Buick Regal
programme.desc: Our '85 Buick gets a new spoiler to help keep the rear on the ground. Plus, HEMI fans get a treat to a visit at Arrington Performance.

programme.title: 1977 F-150 Gets Some Much Needed Upgrades
programme.desc: We open the mailbox and answer some long-awaited viewer questions. We'll also hit the road to rescue a 1977 Ford F150 in need of repair.

programme.title: Adding An EFI Setup To The C1500 Chevy
programme.desc: We bring our C1500 Abandoned Chevy back into the shop for an easy to install EFI setup that will allow for more boost and power. Plus we head out to Mid-Ohio Sports Car Course to compete with our Spec Panther race car.

programme.title: Swapping In A Performance Clutch On The Spec Miata Racecar - Part 3
programme.desc: The crew starts tearing into the drivetrain and suspension of their Spec Mazda Miata racecar to help it perform better on the track.

programme.title: OBS Chevy C1500 Gets a Cantilevered Rear Suspension
programme.desc: We work on the suspension of a 1989 OBS Chevy C1500 truck. It's an upgrade for the front IFS and a fabricated custom rear suspension to get all that LS Power to the ground.

programme.title: '74 Bronco Chills with Aftermarket Air Conditioning
programme.desc: We wrap up the assembly of our Bronco as it gets a fuel system, exhaust, brakes, trim, gauges, and new air conditioning.

programme.title: Flogging a Stock Jeep JK Before Adding Performance Mods
programme.desc: Our new project Jeep debuts in a junkyard to crush some cars. Then, it's back in the shop to cut fenders for bigger wheels and tires and a lift install.

programme.title: OBS 632 SS Part 7 Refresh and Reuse
programme.desc: Our Silverado 632 SS project is getting close to completion. We relocate our battery and start wiring so we can power our systems. We refurbish some interior pieces to match our new color scheme, then add some extra grip with a traction control module.

programme.title: How To Lift And Level Your Truck For More Clearance
programme.desc: When adding bigger wheels and tires to your vehicle may cause some problems with clearance. We show you some quick solutions to get you rolling again.

programme.title: Driveway Rescue: Everyday Charger
programme.desc: We meet a guy who turned his vintage Dodge into a daily driver... and help him fix it!

programme.title: Toughening Up The '91 Suburban With New Axles And A 4-Link Coilover Kit
programme.desc: Our GMC "Unbreakable" Suburban gets its new suspension along with a good sanding and paint job to help get it ready for the real world.

programme.title: Single Cylinder Special
programme.desc: We show you how to have lots of fun building engines on a budget. We dive into the world of small engines doing a multi-stage build on a 212 CC Go-Kart engine, and we test some easy, bolt-on upgrades on the chassis dyno and behind the wheel.

programme.title: Faux Guy Square Body Shifts Into Gear With A New Transfer Case
programme.desc: Our K-10 Square body is starting to come back to life. The cab, body panels and bed all get reassembled. We add cooling, electrical, resto parts and measure the driveshaft and finalize the transmission linkage. The end is in sight!

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 4: Making The Bed
programme.desc: The MCT Crew have the frame shortened on Project Cream Puff and it's ready for its new bed. The guys give you a couple of options on how to tackle a short bed conversion, then start assembling their new one. Plus, get a little help with choosing what kind of floor we want for our custom C-10.

programme.title: Testing 4 Common Engine Building Myths: Which Ones Are True?
programme.desc: Want to build your best powerplant? It starts with understanding the fundamentals of engine building: valve lash, header sizing, and more!

programme.title: Road Course Camaro Part 10 Custom Dash Panel
programme.desc: The guys show you how to create a custom steering column for your race car that won't break the bank. Plus, they will fabricate a custom dash to accept their new digital gauge cluster, and show you an easy way to wire your project.

programme.title: Ford vs Chevy: Small Displacement Showdown
programme.desc: The TIMELESS Debate is on. Ford vs. Chevy. We start with a stock 305 Chevy and a 302 Ford. After an initial baseline, we see how they stack up against each other with the same mild upgrades. We find out, dollar for horsepower, who comes out on top.

programme.title: Building Bigfoot: What It Takes To Create A Monster Truck
programme.desc: We take a road trip to the outskirts of St. Louis to meet with the team responsible for Bigfoot! We have access to the inner workings, get a sneak peek at a new Bigfoot, and we're going to drive a monster truck!

programme.title: Bringing The Thunder To Our Hurst Olds With 80's Style And Big Power
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel roll an '83 Hurst Olds into the shop and install brakes, wheels, and tires to lay the groundwork for adding some thunder back into this classic lightning shifted street seeker.

programme.title: 440ci Motown LS Race Engine: Part II
programme.desc: We finish the assembly of our 440 with a conventional SBC bottom end and LS induction. Then we put it on the dyno and see how many ponies it puts out!

programme.title: Project Rapid Runner is Complete - SEMA Build Part 2
programme.desc: Challenging times are coming as the deadline of Project Rapid Runner comes into view. Chris and Eric's 2025 Nissan Frontier Pro 4X still has a ton of work needed to finish up in time for SEMA. Can they do it?

programme.title: From a Flat-Head to a Chrysler Slant-Six, to a Ford FE to a boosted Chevy Straight-Six
programme.desc: From a Flat-Head to a Chrysler Slant-Six, from a Ford FE to a boosted Chevy Straight-Six, Mike and Pat celebrate their vintage builds and how they turned retro into big modern muscle.

programme.title: Boosting A Crown Vic Police Interceptor 160 Horsepower
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc almost double the horsepower on a 2008 Ford 4.6L Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor. The solution for more power is adding a small tailpipe turbo, exhaust and fuel mods. Then the dyno don't lie! From 200HP to 368HP, this Vic is ready for high pursuit!

programme.title: Turning A Mazda Miata From Street Car to Spec Race Car - Part 1
programme.desc: The Carcass crew heads out to the NCM Motorsports Park for a High Performance Driving Experience! Then they take their new project car, a Mazda Miata, out on the track to get baseline numbers! Plus we add performance parts to get a boost in power!

programme.title: Mopar Big Block and Transmission Drop
programme.desc: Today, our 1969 Dodge Dart, Project Bullseye, gets a major power upgrade. We also get our brakes lined out and connect all the steering linkage for total control. The icing on the cake, we paint the scooped hood and add our Swinger stripe.

programme.title: Installing an Aluminum Bed Floor Kit in a Chevy C10
programme.desc: Our Lo 'n Slo, C10 project breaks tradition by ditching its rotted wood bed floor for an easy install aluminum kit that mimics the real thing. Plus, the guys in Engine Power explode our 292 straight-six for a full rebuild.

programme.title: What Muscle Car is Right For You
programme.desc: We look at several projects like Hard Charger - our 1969 Dodge Hellcat Charger, Sydewinder - our 1981 Fox Body Mustang Cobra, our 1966 Pontiac Convertible, and our 2016 Ford Mustang GT. We'll give you a play by play of what it takes to build each one to help you decide what avenue to take for your vehicle.

programme.title: Building 1974 Bronco From The Ground Up
programme.desc: With the help of some master craftsmen, the guys start building a Bronco from the ground up, one that will cruise the beach, scream down the interstate, and everything in between.

programme.title: How Much Power Can Bolt On Upgrades Add To a F-150 Sport Truck?
programme.desc: We revisit the F150 Dream Truck and find out what bolt on upgrades actually do to your horsepower numbers, and we'll test it on the dyno.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 9: Low Ride, High Power
programme.desc: Project Cream Puff takes a huge step forward in this episode as the MCT crew installs an air-ride suspension system, giving the build its signature low, effortless stance while cruising the streets. Plus, we'll unleash some serious power with the addition of a supercharged boost, transforming our C-10 into a street machine with both style and muscle.

programme.title: Bolt-On 100+ Horsepower in a Day
programme.desc: Power upgrades are great especially if you can bolt-on big performance in a day. Mike and Pat grab some wrenches to install a ProCharger supercharger on a 2019 Challenger ProCharger.

programme.title: Lowering And Chopping The Bed On The Turbocharged Ford 300 Flatbed
programme.desc: We bring our now turbocharged 1964 Ford F350 flatbed shop truck back for upgrades. We'll bob the bed by cutting the frame, build and install a new exhaust, and then drive it like we stole it!

programme.title: Bonfire
programme.desc: A greedy preacher (Peter Falk) lets an elderly woman die, then pursues her heiress niece. With Dina Merrill.

programme.title: Tender Poisoner
programme.desc: An executive (Howard Duff) plans to end an associate's (Dan Dailey) love affair and save the man's career and marriage.

programme.title: Festive Season
programme.desc: A lawyer (Edmon Ryan) spends Christmas Eve trying to reconcile a feuding brother (Richard Waring) and sister (Carmen Mathews).

programme.title: Listen, Listen ... !
programme.desc: A man tries to convince the authorities that he knows who committed the latest murder in a series of strangulations, but no one will listen to him.

programme.title: Post-Mortem
programme.desc: A woman (Joanna Moore) learns that a winning sweepstakes ticket is in the suit her former husband was buried in. With Steve Forrest and James Gregory.

programme.title: The Crocodile Case
programme.desc: A crocodile valise becomes a vital clue in tracking down a murderer (Denholm Elliott).

programme.title: The Safe Place
programme.desc: A bank teller (Robert H. Harris) invents a seemingly foolproof plan to come up with a lot of quick cash. With Jerry Paris and Philip Pine.

programme.title: The Canary Sedan
programme.desc: While traveling in chauffeured car, a woman (Jessica Tandy) with psychic powers hears a voice telling a tragic love story.

programme.title: Impromptu Murder
programme.desc: A lawyer, soon to become mayor, extends an invitation to a woman who once accused him of embezzlement.

programme.title: Little White Frock
programme.desc: An old, unemployed actor (Herbert Marshall) uses an even older ploy to get a part in a play. With Tom Helmore and Julia Adams.

programme.title: Don't Interrupt
programme.desc: A couple (Biff McGuire, Cloris Leachman) on a train promise their son money if he doesn't interrupt a cowboy's (Chill Wills) story.

programme.title: The Jokester
programme.desc: A morgue attendant becomes hysterical when a practical joker pulls the ultimate prank and pretends to be a corpse.

programme.title: Crooked Road
programme.desc: A couple (Richard Kiley, Pat Breslin) falls prey to a crooked policeman (Walter Matthau) and corrupt town officials.

programme.title: $2,000,000 Defense
programme.desc: Desperate for an acquittal, a man (Leslie Nielsen) makes a lucrative deal with his defense lawyer (Barry Sullivan).

programme.title: Design for Loving
programme.desc: A man (Norman Lloyd) plots to get away from his wife (Marian Seldes) for a while without her knowing.

programme.title: Man With a Problem
programme.desc: A man (Gary Merrill) on the ledge of a New York City hotel threatens suicide after his wife's (Elizabeth Montgomery) death.

programme.title: Safety of the Witness
programme.desc: A gun shop owner (Art Carney) witnesses the murder of a state witness by two gangsters. With Mary Scott.

programme.title: Mrs. Herman & Mrs. Fenimore

programme.title: Out There, Darkness
programme.desc: A rich woman refuses to lend money to the man who walks her dog when he requests a loan, claiming to need the money to help his girlfriend.

programme.title: Total Loss
programme.desc: A woman (Nancy Gates) enlists her boyfriend's (Ralph Meeker) help to torch her struggling business for the insurance.

programme.title: The Last Dark Step
programme.desc: A man (Robert Horton) tries to get away from one woman (Fay Spain) so he can marry another (Joyce Meadows).

programme.title: Morning of the Bride
programme.desc: A woman (Barbara Bel Geddes) grows suspicious when her fiancé (Don Dubbins) postpones meetings with his mother.

programme.title: The Diamond Necklace
programme.desc: A man is told he has to retire from his job at the jewelry store where he has worked most of his life.

programme.title: Relative Value
programme.desc: A young man (Denholm Elliott) schemes to speed up his inheritance of his rich uncle's (Torin Thatcher) estate.

programme.title: The Right Price
programme.desc: A burglar bargains with his victims when he discovers robbery will not be as profitable as collecting on a life insurance policy.

programme.title: I'll Take Care of You
programme.desc: A used car salesman (Ralph Meeker) is driven to murder by his big-spending wife. With Russell Collins and Ida Moore.

programme.title: The Avon Emeralds
programme.desc: A detective (Roger Moore) trails an elegant woman (Hazel Court) suspected of smuggling an emerald necklace.

programme.title: The Kind Waitress
programme.desc: A waitress (Olive Deering) plots murder after learning she has been included in a wealthy patron's will.

programme.title: Cheap Is Cheap
programme.desc: A miserly man (Dennis Day) searches for the cheapest method of murdering his spendthrift wife.

programme.title: The Waxwork
programme.desc: A reporter gets permission from the owner of a wax museum to spend the night in the museum section devoted to murderers.

programme.title: The Impossible Dream
programme.desc: A smitten woman (Carmen Mathews) sees the chance for her dream to come true when she witnesses a murder. With Franchot Tone and Mary Astor.

programme.title: Banquo's Chair
programme.desc: A Scotland Yard inspector (John Williams) arranges a unique ruse to capture a killer. With Hilda Plowright and Kenneth Haigh.

programme.title: The 31st of February
programme.desc: A suspicious sergeant (William Conrad) digs when a death is labeled accidental. With David Wayne.

programme.title: What Really Happened
programme.desc: A woman (Anne Francis) stands trial for her husband's murder, and the family maid (Ruth Roman) holds the key to the truth.

programme.title: Forecast: Low Clouds, Coastal Fog
programme.desc: A woman (Inger Stevens) thinks her refusal of the use of her phone led to a murder. With Dan O'Herlihy.

programme.title: A Tangled Web
programme.desc: A girl's (Zohra Lampert) deep love for a compulsive thief (Robert Redford) infuriates his jealous accomplice (Barry Morse).

programme.title: To Catch a Butterfly
programme.desc: When a young couple moves into a new neighborhood, they find their lives threatened by the little boy next door.

programme.title: The Paragon
programme.desc: A man (Gary Merrill) must stop his wife (Joan Fontaine) from alienating family and friends.

programme.title: I'll Be Judge, I'll Be Jury
programme.desc: The relatives (Ed Nelson, Sarah Marshall) of a murdered newlywed decide to bring the killer to justice. With Peter Graves.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Danger
programme.desc: An anthrax epidemic devastates Los Angeles, and authorities race to find the carrier. With Michael Parks.

programme.title: A Night With the Boys
programme.desc: Fearing his pregnant wife's (Joyce Meadows) displeasure, a man (John Smith) fakes being mugged to cover poker losses.

programme.title: Your Witness
programme.desc: A woman, dissatisfied in her marriage to a philandering attorney, decides to take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Human Interest Story
programme.desc: A man declaring he is from Mars (Arthur Hill) is interviewed by a newspaper reporter (Steve McQueen).

programme.title: The Dusty Drawer
programme.desc: A man (Dick York) seeks revenge on a bank clerk (Philip Coolidge) who once stole some money from him.

programme.title: A True Account
programme.desc: A woman (Jane Greer) consults an attorney (Robert Webber) about her husband (Kent Smith), whom she believes is a murderer.

programme.title: Touché
programme.desc: A husband (Paul Douglas) arranges for a young man (Robert Morse) to kill his wife's latest beau in a duel.

programme.title: Invitation to an Accident
programme.desc: When a cheating wife is in an accident, her jealous husband is confronted about his possible involvement with the incident.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A chicken farmer murders his gold-digging girlfriend, but the police can't convict him without the body.

programme.title: The Crystal Trench
programme.desc: The loyal widow (Patricia Owens) of a man killed in a mountain-climbing accident recovers his body after 20 years.

programme.title: Appointment at Eleven
programme.desc: An angry young man (Clint Kimbrough) accurately predicts an impending death. With Amy Douglass and Norma Crane.

programme.title: Coyote Moon
programme.desc: A professor (Macdonald Carey) traveling across the country outwits three larcenous hitchhikers.

programme.title: No Pain
programme.desc: A man (Brian Keith) destined to live in an iron lung fears for his life after learning of his wife's (Joanna Moore) infidelity.

programme.title: Anniversary Gift
programme.desc: A hen-pecked husband (Harry Morgan) plans to give his animal-loving wife (Barbara Baxley) a poisonous snake as an anniversary gift.

programme.title: Dry Run
programme.desc: A young thug (Robert Vaughn) tries to prove his worth to a mob boss (David White) by killing a rival mobster (Walter Matthau).

programme.title: The Blessington Method
programme.desc: The representative (Dick York) of a society dedicated to eliminating the elderly makes an offer to a prospective client (Henry Jones).

programme.title: Dead Weight
programme.desc: A man (Joseph Cotten) decides to get rid of one potential blackmailer (Don Gordon) only to deal with another. With Julia Adams.

programme.title: Special Delivery
programme.desc: A boy's (Peter Lazer) hobby of growing mushrooms in his cellar turns into a nightmare. With Steve Dunne and Beatrice Straight.

programme.title: Road Hog
programme.desc: A father (Raymond Massey) seeks revenge against a road hog (Robert Emhardt) who caused his son's death.

programme.title: Specialty of the House
programme.desc: A man's (Robert Morley) dream of becoming a lifetime member of an exclusive gourmet restaurant comes true.

programme.title: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
programme.desc: A Southerner (Ronald Howard) is about to be hanged for attempting to destroy a bridge vital to the Union's advance.

programme.title: Graduating Class

programme.title: The Ikon of Elijah

programme.title: The Cure
programme.desc: When it becomes evident his wife is losing her grip on reality, a man turns to his devoted servant for help in the Amazon.

programme.title: Backward, Turn Backward

programme.title: Not the Running Type

programme.title: The Day of the Bullet

programme.title: Hitch Hike
programme.desc: A businessman (John McIntire) has second thoughts about having picked up a young hitchhiker (Robert Morse). With Suzanne Pleshette.

programme.desc: A son (George Grizzard) encourages his controlling mother (Patricia Collinge) to join her dead husband.

programme.desc: A woman (Beatrice Straight) in an isolated cabin encounters a stranger (Fay Spain) she believes is an escaped mental patient.

programme.title: Forty Detectives Later
programme.desc: A man's (George Mitchell) search for his wife's murderer leads to a confrontation. With James Franciscus and Jack Weston.

programme.title: The Hero
programme.desc: Aboard a ship bound for South Africa, a businessman (Eric Portman) meets a partner (Oscar Homolka) he left for dead.

programme.title: The Lonely Hour

programme.title: The Star Juror
programme.desc: After a mild-mannered man commits a strangulation, he becomes a juror in the trial of the man accused of the crime.

programme.title: The Long Silence
programme.desc: A paralyzed woman (Phyllis Thaxter) must somehow communicate her husband is a killer before she becomes his next victim.

programme.title: An Out for Oscar
programme.desc: After a naive man (Larry Storch) weds a beautiful woman (Linda Christian), he learns she did not marry him for love.

programme.title: Death and the Joyful Woman
programme.desc: The secretary (Laraine Day) of a wine baron murders when her dream of marrying him is shattered.

programme.title: Last Seen Wearing Blue Jeans
programme.desc: A girl (Katherine Crawford) gets into the wrong car at an Arizona café and witnesses a murder in Mexico.

programme.title: The Dark Pool
programme.desc: After an adopted son drowns, a strange woman (Madlyn Rhue) arrives claiming to be the boy's natural mother.

programme.title: White Elephant
programme.desc: When two cops witness an assassination attempt, a ruthless crime boss orders Gabriel Tancredi, an ex-Marine turned mob enforcer, to eliminate any and all threats. With an eager underling out to prove himself, rival gangs making moves, and a rising body count, every step Tancredi makes threatens lives -- including his own.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Venice
programme.desc: Steve Ford is a private detective in Venice Beach, Calif., who's good with the ladies, bad with the punches and wild about his dog Buddy. When local thugs steal Buddy, Ford turns to Spyder, their devious leader, and forges an unlikely alliance. With help from his best friend, Steve pulls out the big guns to retrieve Spyder's stolen cash and cocaine and save Buddy.

programme.title: Dog Eat Dog
programme.desc: Ex-cons, Troy (Nicolas Cage), Mad Dog (Willem Dafoe) and Diesel (Christopher Matthew Cook), are hired by an eccentric mob boss to kidnap a baby and hold it for a large ransom. When the abduction goes awry, the men find themselves on the run from the mob and the cops. Vowing to stay out of prison at all costs, getting away with the crime is a matter of life and death.

programme.title: American Star
programme.desc: An assassin on his last assignment travels to Fuerteventura to kill a man he's never met.

programme.title: True History of the Kelly Gang
programme.desc: An exploration of Australian bushranger Ned Kelly and his gang as they attempt to evade authorities during the 1870s.

programme.title: The Dry
programme.desc: A federal agent investigates the decades-old death of a teenage girl in his drought-stricken hometown.

programme.title: Terminal
programme.desc: In the dark heart of a sprawling and anonymous city, two assassins carry out a sinister mission, a teacher battles a fatal illness, an enigmatic janitor and a curious waitress lead a dangerous double life. Murderous consequences unravel in the dead of night as their lives all intertwine at the hands of a mysterious criminal mastermind who is hell-bent on revenge.

programme.title: The Tax Collector
programme.desc: Two enforcers for a crime lord face an uncertain future when an old rival reappears.

programme.title: Official Secrets
programme.desc: One day in 2003, in the lead up to the Iraq War, British intelligence specialist Katharine Gun receives a memo from the NSA with a shocking directive: the United States is enlisting Britain's help in collecting compromising information on U.N. Security Council members to blackmail them into voting in favor of an invasion of Iraq. Unable to stand by and watch the world be rushed into war, Gun makes the gut-wrenching decision to defy her government and leak the memo to the press.

programme.title: White Elephant
programme.desc: When two cops witness an assassination attempt, a ruthless crime boss orders Gabriel Tancredi, an ex-Marine turned mob enforcer, to eliminate any and all threats. With an eager underling out to prove himself, rival gangs making moves, and a rising body count, every step Tancredi makes threatens lives -- including his own.

programme.title: A Score to Settle
programme.desc: Diagnosed with a fatal condition, a mob enforcer leaves prison after 19 years and plots a bloody course of revenge against his old gang.

programme.title: Surveillance
programme.desc: A seemingly normal security guard (Armand Assante) reveals a sinister side.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: A woman's carefully constructed life gets upended when an unwelcome shadow from her past returns, forcing her to confront the monster she's evaded for two decades.

programme.title: Night of the Hunted
programme.desc: When Alice stops at a remote gas station at night, she's made the plaything of a crazy sniper with a secret vendetta. To survive, she must figure out who wants her dead.

programme.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment
programme.desc: In 1971, Stanford's Professor Philip Zimbardo (Billy Crudup) conducts a controversial psychology experiment in which college students pretend to be either prisoners or guards, but the proceedings soon get out of hand.

programme.title: The Other Lamb
programme.desc: A young woman born into an all-female cult begins to question the teachings of her leader.

programme.title: Swallow
programme.desc: A young housewife in a seemingly perfect marriage develops pica, the irresistible urge to ingest inedible objects and material.

programme.title: The Other Man
programme.desc: When his shoe-designer wife, Lisa (Laura Linney), disappears while on one of her frequent business trips, computer executive Peter (Liam Neeson) stumbles upon evidence that she has been having an affair with the dashing Italian Ralph (Antonio Banderas). Impulsively flying to Milan to search for his wife despite the pleadings of their college-age daughter, Abigail (Romola Garai), Peter enters into a complicated charade by befriending Ralph and slowly teasing information about Lisa out of him.

programme.title: The Last Thing Mary Saw
programme.desc: In the spring of 1840, a family gathers in their old, isolated farm house to mourn the loss of their matriarch. As the mourning proceeds, the circumstances of the matriarch's death come into question.

programme.title: The Beta Test
programme.desc: A married Hollywood agent receives a mysterious letter for an anonymous sexual encounter and becomes ensnared in a sinister world of lying, murder and infidelity.

programme.title: Dog Eat Dog
programme.desc: Ex-cons, Troy (Nicolas Cage), Mad Dog (Willem Dafoe) and Diesel (Christopher Matthew Cook), are hired by an eccentric mob boss to kidnap a baby and hold it for a large ransom. When the abduction goes awry, the men find themselves on the run from the mob and the cops. Vowing to stay out of prison at all costs, getting away with the crime is a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The Owners
programme.desc: An elderly couple turn the tables on a group of young thieves who broke into their house while they were away.

programme.title: Impetigore
programme.desc: A woman inherits a house in her ancestral village, but she is unaware that members of the community have been trying to locate and kill her to remove the curse that has plagued them for years.

programme.title: Dead Mail
programme.desc: A post office employee investigates the mysterious origins of a blood-stained note that was sent by a captive man.

programme.title: Night of the Hunted
programme.desc: When Alice stops at a remote gas station at night, she's made the plaything of a crazy sniper with a secret vendetta. To survive, she must figure out who wants her dead.

programme.title: I Sell the Dead
programme.desc: Arthur Blake (Dominic Monaghan) is about to be executed by guillotine for the crime of grave robbing. But before he faces the blade, he agrees to confess to Father Duffy (Ron Perlman) in the hope that the priest might be merciful enough to spare his life. Arthur tells his life story to the priest, which begins with him stealing valuables from the deceased as a youth. But as he relates his battles with zombies, ghosts and other fiendish ghouls, his tale takes a turn for the supernatural.

programme.title: Nuevas experiencias
programme.desc: Carolina le dice a Lety que Aldo está encantado con ella. Aldo lleva a Lety a bucear y navegar. Irma presenta a su familia en Conceptos. Rebeca le informa a Luigi que quiere llevarse a Irma a Estados Unidos. Tomás acude de nuevo a la junta de Comité.

programme.title: Ahogado en un bar
programme.desc: Mónica le cuenta a Marcia que vio a Fernando muy borracho en un bar y que el barman lo estaba mandando a su casa en taxi; Marcia, a su vez, se lo cuenta a Teresita y ella se aflige mucho.

programme.title: Paseo en moto
programme.desc: Jessica le dice a Carolina que su miedo desapareció gracias a los consejos de Lety. Marcia le cuenta a Alicia que Fernando confesó estar enamorado de Lety. Aldo lleva a Lety en motocicleta por el puerto de Acapulco.

programme.title: Alianza femenina
programme.desc: Fernando le llama la atención a Alicia por no pasarle las llamadas y la molesta por la relación que tuvo con Tomás; Teresita le propone a Marcia una alianza para sacar adelante Conceptos.

programme.title: El dueño
programme.desc: Omar le dice a Teresita quién es el dueño de Conceptos; Simón le dice a Teresita y Marcia que Fernando salió de la empresa en muy malas condiciones; Fernando se estaciona enfrente de la lancha de Aldo.

programme.title: Golpeado en un bar
programme.desc: Fernando es sacado de un bar todo golpeado, pero logra volver a entrar; Lety interviene entre Aldo y Fausto para que se reconcilien; Fausto le entrega a Aldo una carta.

programme.title: Una oportunidad
programme.desc: Lety le cuenta a Carolina que pasó toda la noche con Aldo y se dieron un beso, por lo que ya no quiere volverlo a ver; Carolina le aconseja darse una oportunidad con Aldo.

programme.title: Cocinando juntos
programme.desc: Aldo le pide ayuda a Lety para cocinar para las concursantes del certamen Nuestra Belleza; Lety le pide no hablar de lo que pasó entre ellos; Fernando le confiesa a Omar haber ido a Acapulco para que lo mataran.

programme.title: El día del certamen
programme.desc: Omar y Fernando hablan a la casa de la familia Padilla, pero Julieta les cuelga; las del cuartel, en compañía de Paco, Celso, Simón y Raúl, ven el certamen Nuestra Belleza por televisión.

programme.title: Fórmula mágica
programme.desc: Fernando llega a la residencia de Jorge Flores, quien le da una fórmula para eliminar la tristeza y las angustias, con el fin de volver a ser el mismo de antes, en armonía.

programme.title: Acuerdo
programme.desc: En la junta del comité, don Humberto anuncia que llegó a un acuerdo con don Erasmo para solo meter abogados en lo que concierne a la devolución de la empresa.

programme.title: Sánchez y Rosales
programme.desc: Sara coquetea con Sánchez y Rosales. Don Erasmo habla con Julieta y Tomás del acuerdo al que llegó con don Humberto. Los licenciados Sánchez y Rosales se presentan ante la junta de comité.

programme.title: Perdonar
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Tomás que ya perdonó a Fernando. El licenciado Santa María propone un plan para salvar Conceptos, pero Lety es la única que puede ayudarlos.

programme.title: Cancelación
programme.desc: Marcia se disculpa con Fernando y le promete dejar de insistir en el tema de Lety. Por otra parte, Lety le comparte a Tomás lo que aprendió con Aldo.

programme.title: Desencuentros
programme.desc: Celso no deja a Lety entrar a Conceptos; Paula María se molesta al enterarse de que Simón llevó a Alicia a su casa en la motocicleta; Lola se niega a conciliar con Efrén por la presencia de Jazmín.

programme.title: Lety está de vuelta
programme.desc: Teresita le pide a Marcia que se presente en la sala de juntas; las del cuartel comentan la reacción de Marcia al ver a Lety.

programme.title: Un posible futuro
programme.desc: Aldo sigue a Lety hasta un autobús y se sube detrás de ella; Fernando se encuentra al vidente en un restaurante y recibe premoniciones sobre Lety y Marcia.

programme.title: Los licenciados
programme.desc: El licenciado Sánchez acepta darle seguimiento al divorcio de Lola; Alicia le coquetea al licenciado Santa María, pero no logra salir con él porque Rosales insiste en salir con ella.

programme.title: Relación laboral
programme.desc: Omar le aconseja a Fernando reconquistar a Lety para que no se queden en la calle; Alicia se porta muy raro con Leticia, quien le pide a Marcia poner en claro su relación laboral.

programme.title: Vicepresidente
programme.desc: Luigi les cuenta a Carolina y Aldo por qué don Humberto nombró a Lety presidenta de Conceptos; Lety nombra a Tomás vicepresidente financiero de la empresa.

programme.title: Corajes
programme.desc: Fernando y Simón llegan al bar donde están las del cuartel; Simón hace corajes porque Paula María baila con otro y Fernando se molesta porque hay un hombre junto a Leticia.

programme.title: Ultimátum
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Tomás que les contó a las del cuartel que ya no son novios; el juez concede a Conceptos seis meses para liquidar su adeudo a Filmo Imagen antes de entrar a remate.

programme.title: Nuevo proyecto
programme.desc: Luigi presenta a Aldo con Marcia y le dice que trabajará con él en un proyecto ajeno a Conceptos; Alicia ofende a los pasajeros del autobús antes de bajar.

programme.title: Nuevas oficinas
programme.desc: Raúl instala a Tomás en la antigua oficina de Olarte y, al ver a Alicia hablar con Aldo, piensa que hay algo entre ellos; Lety toma su lugar en la que fue oficina de Fernando; Aldo y Fernando se conocen.

programme.title: Cizaña
programme.desc: Leti le pide a Alicia que cite a Marcia en la sala de juntas y Alicia aprovecha la oportunidad para meter cizaña.

programme.title: Plan de rescate
programme.desc: Marcia le ordena a Luigi presentarse en la junta; Lety informa al consejo sobre las concesiones que dictó el juez y propone el proyecto que pensó con Aldo para reunir el dinero.

programme.title: Reorganizando la empresa
programme.desc: Luigi anuncia que renunciará a Conceptos al terminar la inauguración de la feria gastronómica y pide que contraten a Jazmín.

programme.title: Los dos galanes
programme.desc: Alicia le expresa a Marcia su desacuerdo sobre ser su secretaria; Marcia le pide su renuncia y Alicia se retracta; Aldo le pide a Fernando hablar a solas para conocerse.

programme.title: Antipatía
programme.desc: Lety presenta a Tomás con Aldo; Tomás le dice a Lety que Aldo no le cae muy bien porque Alicia quiere con él.

programme.title: Lo que se regala
programme.desc: Marcia le dice a Alicia que está segura de que Lety y Fernando van a verse porque él la apoyó en todo durante la junta; Lety le dice a Tomás que no pudo tirar los regalos de Fernando y por eso se los regresó.

programme.title: Con el corazón
programme.desc: Aldo le dice a Carolina que el regalo que le compró a Lety no es para conquistarla, pues él la conquistará con el corazón.

programme.title: Chismes en el baño
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Aldo que ya no quiere hablar de Fernando y recordar todo lo que sufrió; Marcia sorprende a las del cuartel hablando sobre ella en el baño.

programme.title: Celos ridículos
programme.desc: Simón le dice a Paula María que su relación seguirá congelada hasta que ella compruebe que no tiene nada que ver con el hombre con el que la encontró bailando.

programme.title: El poder como atractivo
programme.desc: Aldo le aclara a Ariel por qué eligió Conceptos para la promoción. Ariel percibe un mal olor en Fernando, pero él lo niega. Fernando le confiesa a Omar qué es lo que buscaba en la basura.

programme.title: Como un caballero
programme.desc: Tomás defiende a Alicia de los insultos de Ariel; las del cuartel le piden a Sara hacerle caso al licenciado Sánchez para que mejore su actitud con Lola.

programme.title: Tostadas de pata
programme.desc: El licenciado Sánchez invita a Sara a bailar y ella se niega a pesar de las insistencias de Lola; Alicia siente que Aldo quiere molestarla porque la llevó a comer tostadas de pata.

programme.title: Aldo conoce a la familia
programme.desc: Lety le confiesa a Aldo que soñó con Fernando y lo invita a desayunar; Aldo se da cuenta de que perdió la perla que guardó en su saco; Don Erasmo le reclama a Lety por salir tan temprano de la casa.

programme.title: Aceptado
programme.desc: Fernando y Omar se burlan de la exposición de Aldo; los gerentes aceptan el proyecto gracias a Aldo y Fernando; las del cuartel le muestran a Lety la carta que encontraron.

programme.title: Una mala imitación
programme.desc: Alicia se burla de Tomás porque quiere parecerse a Aldo; Tom le agradece a Aldo que lo haya rescatado por segunda vez y le ofrece su amistad.

programme.title: Guillermo
programme.desc: Guillermo llega a Conceptos a quejarse porque le colgaron el teléfono sin tomarle recado y Alicia se deslinda de la responsabilidad; Aldo presenta a Guillermo en la junta.

programme.title: Enterado
programme.desc: Marcia le pregunta a Carolina qué tan cercana es su relación con Lety; Omar le dice a Fernando que Aldo podría estar enterado de su situación con la actual presidenta de Conceptos.

programme.title: El cuartel en la sala de juntas
programme.desc: Marcia se molesta porque las del cuartel comerán con Lety en la sala de juntas; Paula María tira la fotografía de Lety y Aldo y las del cuartel la ven; Lety se ve obligada a contarles cómo conoció a Aldo.

programme.title: Hombres en pugna
programme.desc: Luigi piensa que Aldo habla de Ruli y que pronto se le va a declarar: Alicia le dice a Tomás que le suspendieron el celular y él le presta el suyo; Tomás reta a Aldo y lo llama traidor.

programme.title: Peleando por Lety
programme.desc: Fernando y Aldo se pelean por el amor de Lety hasta que Marcia los separa; Lety piensa que Aldo peleó por ella, pero que Fernando solo peleó por defender conceptos.

programme.title: Reto de aptitudes
programme.desc: Ariel cita a Leticia en una dirección y manda a su chofer para recogerla; Tomás le pregunta qué está pasando y Lety le explica que Ariel quiere probar sus aptitudes para ser presidente de Conceptos.

programme.title: No te merezco
programme.desc: Alicia se duerme con el vestido de novia puesto, esperando que se le cumpla el sueño de casarse con Aldo; Lety escribe en su diario que no merece un amor limpio y desinteresado como el de Aldo.

programme.title: Espionaje fallido
programme.desc: Omar se esconde en la oficina de don Erasmo para espiar a Lety con Aldo, pero lo descubren Lety y Ana Paula; las mujeres del cuartel descubren el nuevo teléfono de Alicia.

programme.title: Karla
programme.desc: Marcia le reclama a Fernando las acciones de Omar; Alicia recibe un préstamo muy importante de parte de su mejor amiga; Fernando conoce a una joven hermosa llamada Karla.

programme.title: Cambio de celular
programme.desc: Las del cuartel dudan de la explicación de Lety sobre el pleito entre Aldo y Alejandro; Omar y Aldo intercambian celulares en el restaurante sin darse cuenta.

programme.title: No te olvido
programme.desc: Omar fracasa en su intento por separar a Lety de Aldo, ganándose la desconfianza de don Erasmo; Fernando se divierte con Karla en Nueva York, pero sigue sin olvidar a Lety.

programme.title: Yo tampoco
programme.desc: Omar sigue espiando a Aldo y a Lety para informar a Fernando de todo lo que hacen; Lety no logra abrir su corazón a este nuevo amor.

programme.title: Historias de desamor
programme.desc: Aldo le cuenta a Lety todo lo que ha sufrido por la muerte de su esposa; Fernando le platica a Karla todo lo que pasó con su asistente, pero ella no deja de impactarse por el físico de Lety.

programme.title: Todavía hay amor
programme.desc: Karla le aconseja a Fernando olvidar a Lety para dejar de sufrir; Omar continúa siguiendo a Lety y a Aldo y ellos lo descubren.

programme.title: La nueva presidenta
programme.desc: Alicia sigue haciendo cambios en la oficina como presidenta de Conceptos; Lety tiene problemas con Aldo porque no logra olvidar a Fernando.

programme.title: De vuelta
programme.desc: Lety regaña a Tomás por comprar el automóvil de Alicia, quien cae en la trampa de las mujeres del cuartel; Fernando regresa de su viaje a Nueva York.

programme.title: Funciona el plan
programme.desc: Omar le cuenta a Fernando todo lo que pasó entre Aldo y Lety; Fernando sorprende a Lety con su nueva actitud; Karla decide visitar a su nuevo amigo.

programme.title: Otro regalo
programme.desc: Lety le confiesa a Tomás lo celosa que está por la cercanía de Fernando con Karla; Martha y Alicia siguen a Fernando y Karla por Conceptos; Aldo le da un importante regalo a su amiga.
