programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: When Sparks Fly
programme.desc: Nick and Tess's relationship, or at least what remains of it, is further tested when she discovers that Nick and Alex have started an intensive farming operation and have dammed off the creek.

programme.title: Show of Love
programme.desc: Alex can't believe it when his first love, Tracy Morrison, shows up at Killarney. She soon makes a very tempting offer to Alex; one that appears to involve more than just a business arrangement.

programme.title: Father's Day
programme.desc: On Charlotte's first birthday, Tess learns she has a fight on her hands when Peter returns wanting full custody of Charlotte. In support, Alex enlists the help of his barrister father Bryce to help Tess in her custody battle.

programme.title: Flesh and Blood
programme.desc: An old abandoned well on Drovers Run holds a forgotten secret for Tess, forcing her to re-evaluate her stance in the custody battle with Peter, and leading her to a difficult decision about Charlotte's future. Meanwhile, Harry and Sandra have a surprise for Alex and Nick.

programme.title: Fool For Love
programme.desc: Stevie's ex-husband arrives at Drovers Run with some surprising news: their divorce never went through and he's here to win her back. Meanwhile, Jodi's fundraising for the CFS gets a boost when she meets new recruit Dylan, and Dave and Nick continue to butt heads over Tess.

programme.title: Make or Break
programme.desc: When Tess's truck breaks down on the way to the sale, a stranger named Bree offers to help. Tess sends Jodi and Bree on to the sale with her cattle, but they end up being kidnapped and Tess must enlist the aid of Nick, Stevie, and Alex on her search.

programme.title: Second Chance
programme.desc: Meg's glamorous sister, Celia Rivers, arrives at Drovers Run. They have a falling out over their disparate lives and Celia heads into the bush in a huff and gets lost. The Drovers women, with Nick and Alex, set out in search of her.

programme.title: Call Me Kate
programme.desc: Jodi battles with what seems like the biggest decision of her life after her old friend Kate Manfredi arrives at the ranch. Tess hires Kate on a three-month probation period because they need all the help they can get at Drovers Run.

programme.title: Desperate and Dateless
programme.desc: Heading to the Bachelor and Spinsters' Ball, the girls from Drovers Run are ready for a big night out. On the way, they pass Dave at a roadside field and newcomer Kate is immediately smitten.

programme.title: Magnetic Attraction
programme.desc: When Stevie's 13-year-old daughter Rose arrives unannounced, life at Drovers Run is thrown into turmoil for everyone, and Stevie is faced with revealing the biggest secret of her life.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take
programme.desc: The weekend of Stevie and Alex's rodeo school has finally arrived and they are excited with the prospect of turning their fresh-faced students into rodeo stars.

programme.title: My Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Stevie and Kane meet under less-than-perfect circumstances when they are brought together by a minor car accident at the truck stop. Despite the awkwardness of their introduction, the charismatic Kane makes a huge impression on Stevie.

programme.title: Saturn Returns
programme.desc: Tess's birthday forces her to take a long, hard look at herself, but she "sees" more than she bargained for and unwittingly creates some midsummer night's madness. Sandra and Harry ask Nick to father a child for them.

programme.title: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Kane's relationships with Stevie and Alex strains their friendship. They are each aiming for Kane's attention: Alex as a mate, Stevie as a lover; but they have no idea that Kane is using them both for his own advantage.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Tess decides to turn traditional courtship on its head and ask Nick to marry her, but it doesn't take long for the rest of the household to find out what she has in mind. Then, Dave makes a discovery that threatens to derail the proposal permanently.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Vin Riley has come looking for Stevie and, more specifically, for the opals he believes are rightfully his. She decides to leave with Kane and the other women are stunned at her sudden decision. Stevie hasn't told them about Vin, so they can't help feeling hurt as she has chosen a life with Kane so quickly.

programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: Feeling that she's been given an omen, Tess becomes increasingly afraid, for Nick, for Charlotte, even for the safety of the pregnant ewes, which she insists be brought in to the house paddock for lambing.

programme.title: Where There's Fire
programme.desc: Just as romance starts blossoming between Jodi and Luke, her position in the Country Fire Service is compromised when suspicion falls on Luke over a series of arson attacks.

programme.title: Trembling on the Brink
programme.desc: After an earth tremor, the cattle are skittish and the bore has dried up on Drovers Run. Tess worries that it is a sign before her wedding to Nick. In the interests of harmony and good omens, Tess decides to invite Sandra to her hens night, something that makes Sandra suspicious.

programme.title: This Moment Forward
programme.desc: Nick and Tess are due to approaching the altar at last, but the imminent arrival of Nick's mother, Liz, strikes a discordant note. Nick is happy to see his mother and Tess is happy to play along, but Liz still has a few bombshells to deliver along with the gift-wrapped knives.

programme.title: Something to Prove
programme.desc: Change is in the air on the outback cattle property of Drovers Run. While Tess and Nick enjoy their honeymoon in Fiji, Stevie becomes intent on proving that she can run the property on her own.

programme.title: My House is Your House
programme.desc: The Drovers girls have a tough time adjusting to Nick as the new "Man of the House," forcing Tess to set out some boundaries in an attempt to keep things running in an orderly manner.

programme.title: A McLeod Daughter
programme.desc: Ghosts of the past are awakened when Jasmine McLeod arrives in the district with the intention of scattering her father's ashes on Drovers Run. Tess is thrown when Nick asks her to update her will.

programme.title: The Things We Do For Love
programme.desc: Tess is thrilled to have her cousin to stay but soon discovers that Jaz is haunted by the death of her fiancé Mark. Mark was killed in a riding accident at an equestrian event where Jaz was a star on the rise.

programme.title: Love Interrupted
programme.desc: Sally Clements, Nick's ex-girlfriend, arrives at Drovers Run with news that is hard to conceal. She is heavily pregnant with Nick's child, conceived during the brief time when Nick was estranged from Tess.

programme.title: Twice Bitten
programme.desc: Tensions are rife with Kane now living in the cottage with Stevie, and Sally staying in the big house with Nick and Tess. Despite Kane's attempts to get 'straight' work, Stevie's suspicions are aroused when she witnesses him talking to Ray, his old car contact.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison.

programme.title: Little White Lies
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison

programme.title: Rules of Disengagement
programme.desc: Meg heads home early from the city in hopes she can be of some comfort to Tess during her time out with Nick. But Meg has little success getting Tess to open up.

programme.title: Once Were Heroes
programme.desc: The stubborn side of Dave is exposed when he finds an injured horse and believes he has found a descendent, a Waler, of the first settlement horses. Meanwhile, Jodi's life is in a downward spiral as her continued absences from work force Stevie to fire her, and her personal life takes a hit too.

programme.title: Return of the Black Queen
programme.desc: Harry is secretly thrilled when he hears Sandra is back in town, however, their initial meeting doesn't go well when they aren't capable of confessing their love.

programme.title: Do You Read Me...?
programme.desc: Incapacitated by an injured foot, a bored Stevie has become addicted to the two-way radio, which causes her to get involved in with a mystery man. Meanwhile, Sandra offers Kate a farm manager's job.

programme.title: Taking Care of Business
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run are no longer a team of four. Kate is now working with Sandra as an overseer at Kinsella's. Jodi has gone into business for herself, selling cosmetics, and the work is tough.

programme.title: Old Flames
programme.desc: When Kate organises a reunion of the high school hiking club, she isn't prepared for the old feelings it's about to stir up. For Jodi, the reunion is fraught with tension as she faces her old rival, Natalie, and she ends up introducing Luke as the local mechanic, rather than as her boyfriend.

programme.title: Body Blows
programme.desc: When Harry suffers a stroke, he reconsiders his plans for Killarney and he makes it clear that he favours Nick over Alex.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: Nick discovers that Harry's heart condition could be quite serious and he goes into denial. Helping Tess with the hay, he works recklessly and has a frightful accident with the hay bales.

programme.title: Boy Made Good
programme.desc: Will Hamilton, an old boyfriend from Stevie's school days in Broken Hill shows up at Drovers Run. He is also the father of Rose, a daughter he has no idea exists. Will is at first shocked to learn he is a father but delights Stevie by wanting to know all about their daughter.

programme.title: The Pearl
programme.desc: In trouble again, Luke promises a concerned Jodi that he will extricate himself from the criminal's grasp, but his problems only escalate. Stevie urges Jodi to distance herself from Luke, but Jodi needs to give him one final chance. She rushes to the truck stop and is shattered to discover drugs hidden in Luke's wardrobe.

programme.title: The Prodigal Daughter
programme.desc: Tess's other cousin, Regan, visits Drovers Run and causes a few problems. Ultimately, Stevie must rely on Regan's help to escape a life-threatening farm accident and Regan must face her fears to save Stevie.

programme.title: Love and Obsession
programme.desc: Dave and Regan's flirtation steps up a level when Dave offers to help cure her of her animal phobia. As they fall for each other, Kate realises Regan has a secret she'll do anything to protect.

programme.title: One Long, Long Day
programme.desc: Tess learns Nick has been offered a job in Argentina and she makes the difficult decision that they will go overseas for six months. Meanwhile, Stevie takes care of Charlotte for the afternoon, but when the child goes missing, she turns Drovers Run upside down to find her. As Dave and Regan's romance blossoms, Kate is devastated.

programme.title: Down to Earth
programme.desc: Things are in a state of flux, if not panic, with the imminent departure of Tess and Nick. Stevie is now in charge, and she decides Kate and Jodi need to sort out who's going to take on her old overseer's job.

programme.title: Heart of Gold
programme.desc: When Regan starts the process to mine Drovers Run, the other women put up a fight and vow to stop her.

programme.title: Taking Flight
programme.desc: Today is Harry's birthday and he's in a foul mood. Alex is stuck giving Sandra a lift to Gungellan so that she can get to an appointment. Kate tries to avoid Dave during a birdcall competition, but he makes it difficult.

programme.title: Make Believe
programme.desc: Kate's grandmother comes for a visit and Kate is in hot water because her grandmother believes that she's engaged to Dave and she runs Drovers Run.

programme.title: Heaven and Earth
programme.desc: Harry buys the truck stop and appoints Moira as manager, leaving Terry as a lowly mechanic. The approach of a raging dust storm adds to the troubles at Drovers Run and Stevie struggles to save the life of Tess's horse Oscar.

programme.title: Moonstruck
programme.desc: Stevie borrows a water pump but leaves without the right hose when she learns that Alex won't be taking her to the ball. The wrong hose causes a tank to fill with toxic gas, and Alex shows up to help, but he is overcome by the fumes.

programme.title: If You Build It...
programme.desc: Stevie locks horns with Sandra during a drought but later helps her through a personal crisis, which temporarily eases tensions between them.

programme.title: Out of Time
programme.desc: Stevie thrilled at the prospect of a visit from Rose but things sour when Stevie's sister Michelle arrives with her. Protective of her adopted daughter, Michelle doesn't want the usually rash Stevie to take matters into her own hands and tell Rose the truth about who her real mother is.

programme.title: Betwixt and Between
programme.desc: Caught off guard when Rose discovers a baby's hospital bracelet, Stevie tells a half-truth: she did have a baby, but she put it up for adoption. Rose finds out the whole truth and takes off in the ute, accidentally reversing into the cattle yard gates.

programme.title: Truth or Dare
programme.desc: Patrick, Dave's adventurer brother literally parachutes onto Drovers Run and ensnares Kate's heart. In the wake of Patrick's appearance, Dave must deal with painful memories and a shocking family secret that's been hidden for years.

programme.title: The King and I
programme.desc: Jodi is on top of the world when she receives a birthday gift from the deceased Jack McLeod. Meanwhile, Dave begins training a new veterinary student. Alex wants to get out of doing an interview for local radio, which Harry has delegated to him.

programme.title: Intentions
programme.desc: Dave is forced to question his behaviour when his former student, Catriona, threatens him with a sexual harassment suit. Meanwhile, after confronting Meg about Jack's gift to her, Jodi feels that her whole life has been a lie.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: Meg agonises over Jodi's rejection of her, following the revelation that Jack McLeod is possibly her real father. Jodi reads her mother's novel, which is based on real life and details the mystery surrounding her birth.

programme.title: Twelve and A Half Hours Behind
programme.desc: When Tess returns home to Drovers Run, she discovers the exciting news that she's pregnant. Her joy is soon turned to grief, though, when a call comes from Argentina saying that the plane Nick was traveling on has been reported missing.

programme.title: Jim Nabors
programme.desc: Series premiere guest: Jim Nabors; highlights include an interview with Shirley Dimple, Jim and Carol as two misfit skiers in The Ski Lodge and more.

programme.title: Valerie Harper and Tim Conway
programme.desc: Carol welcomes Valerie Harper and Tim Conway as her guests; Valerie joins Carol on a blind double date; Tim is the world's oldest fireman; ham actor Harvey's newest co-star is a miscast Charo type.

programme.title: Ken Berry, Natalie Cole
programme.desc: Ken Berry and Natalie Cole are tonight's guests; a courtroom drama featuring Tim; he's been influenced by television and has seemingly turned into a rascally rabbit.

programme.title: Tim Conway
programme.desc: Guest: Tim Conway.

programme.title: Soupy Sales, Mel Tormé, Ronald Reagan
programme.desc: Soupy Sales; Mel Tormé; Ronald Reagan.

programme.title: Jack Weston
programme.desc: Guest star Jack Weston matches up with Carol on a computer date; Carol sings "The Lady Is A Tramp"; Harvey plays Dr. Jekyll, with none other than Carol as his Ms. Hyde.

programme.title: Nanette Fabray, Burt Reynolds
programme.desc: Carol's guests are Burt Reynolds and Nanette Fabray; they join the gang for a series of Carol's patented commercial parodies, and the late night adventure movie "The Lavender Pimpernel."

programme.title: Bob Newhart
programme.desc: Carol and Roger fight when his accountant brings over his wife; a woman badgers Harvey for a donation.

programme.title: Jim Nabors
programme.desc: A married country music singing duo announce their impending divorce; new regular Dick Van Dyke plays Ed's old Army buddy in "The Family"; two bumbling workmen install a plate-glass window in a boutique; guest Jim Nabors.

programme.title: The Carol Burnett Show
programme.desc: Maggie Smith returns to guest star as the erudite teacher of Eunice and Ed's son Bubba in another installment of The Family; a newly remodeled kitchen falls apart around Carol and Harvey.

programme.title: Wayne Rogers, Buddy Ebsen
programme.desc: The Dakota County Fair; War is Heck.

programme.title: Tim Conway, Charo
programme.desc: Guest stars Tim Conway and Charo; in separate sketches, Tim plays a man at a unisex salon, a fellow trying to stay awake for a speech, and a journalist meeting "Chiquita" (Charo) and her mother (Carol.)

programme.title: Anthony Newley and Dick Martin
programme.desc: Guests Anthony Newley and Dick Martin are anything but clueless in tonight's tribute to detectives in the movies; Carol and Vicki are single and ready to mingle in a sketch set in a singles bar.

programme.title: Jim Nabors
programme.desc: Carol's good luck charm Jim Nabors guest stars; this episode is highlighted by Harvey's belated Emmy Award acceptance speech, and a Nostalgia Theatre presentation of the WWII-set Hollywood Canteen.

programme.title: Ken Berry, Cass Elliot
programme.desc: Guests Mama Cass Elliot and Ken Berry offer up some musical numbers and a series of commercial parodies.

programme.title: Richard Chamberlain, Kay Medford, Gloria Loring
programme.desc: Guest star Richard Chamberlain gives it his all in "Gone With The Breeze"; fellow guest Gloria Loring takes center stage for an impressive musical performance.

programme.title: Cher
programme.desc: Tonight's guest star is Cher; sketches include Harvey and Tim as dueling pianists, spoofs of commercials, and a love triangle between Harvey, Cher, and Carol as the mousy other woman.

programme.title: Steve Lawrence
programme.desc: Steve Lawrence steps into the Fred MacMurray role in a take-off on the classic noir film "Double Indemnity" here named "Double Calamity", with Carol in the femme fatale role.

programme.title: Ronnie Schell, Vicki Carr
programme.desc: Guests Ronnie Schell and Vikki Carr take to the stage with stand-up and song; meanwhile, a touring star, Harvey, treads the boards in a play with a small town co-star in search of a bigger role.

programme.title: Steve Lawrence
programme.desc: Tonight's guest is Mr. Steve Lawrence; Steve joins Carol in a sketch about a travelling couple sharing some honesty with each other on a plane they think is about to crash.

programme.title: Carl Reiner
programme.desc: Carl Reiner joins Carol; Carl appears in two sketches: as the husband of an accident-prone woman, and as a marriage counselor to a comedienne and her spouse.

programme.title: Tim Conway
programme.desc: Tim Conway plays The Oldest Galley Slave, an ad exec paying a visit on actress Nora Desmond, and a lawyer who happens to be a rabbit.

programme.title: Tim Conway
programme.desc: Harvey and Carol encounter a wishing well; in another installment of "The Family", Eunice and Ed suffer through Mama's recuperation after an accident.

programme.title: Family Show
programme.desc: Carol introduces the actors who dub her and Harvey's voices for Spanish language audiences, using a classic "Carol & Sis" sketch to demonstrate their talents.

programme.title: Bernadette Peters, Tim Conway
programme.desc: Bernadette Peters and Tim Conway guest star in a head-spinning installment of "As The Stomach Turns" spoofing "The Exorcist" in the process; Tim and Harvey play Japanese sailors in a tiny sub.

programme.title: Jane Connell, Tim Conway
programme.desc: Guests include Jane Connell.

programme.title: Robert Goulet
programme.desc: Carol is caught between two handsome men; the aftermath of a raucous party; a maid entranced by a self-absorbed star.

programme.title: Andy Griffith, Helen Reddy
programme.desc: Highlights include "Rebecky" (a spoof of the 1940 version of "Rebecca") with Carol in the Joan Fontaine role and Vicki as Mrs. Danvers.

programme.title: Vincent Price and Joan Rivers
programme.desc: Guests: Vincent Price and Joan Rivers.

programme.title: Dinah Shore
programme.desc: A spoof of "Gone With the Wind"; two business professionals discuss his marriage proposal like a business meeting: the Old Man runs a butcher shop where he wreaks havoc with an impatient customer; guest Dinah Shore.

programme.title: The Carol Burnett Show
programme.desc: Guest: Steve Lawrence.

programme.title: Kay Cole
programme.desc: A distraught driver visits the man she backed over in a parking lot; a parched soldier in the desert tries to convince his commanding officer that the bar and barmaid he sees aren't mirages; guest Kay Cole.

programme.title: William Conrad
programme.desc: Guests William Conrad and Isabel Sanford; a series of short television spoofs; featuring another installment of "Carol & Sis."

programme.title: Martha Raye and Mike Douglas
programme.desc: Martha Raye and Mike Douglas.

programme.title: Paul Sand and Eydie Gorrme
programme.desc: Paul Sand and Eydie Gormé guest star. Including a salute to movie series such as "Dr. Kildare"; Paul and Eydie join Carol for an outrageous werewolf sketch.

programme.title: Imogene Coca, Mel Tormé
programme.desc: Guests: Imogene Coca and Mel Tormé.

programme.title: Eydie Gormé, Shecky Greene

programme.title: Tim Conway
programme.desc: Carol Burnett, an ensemble cast and guest stars entertain their audience; includes VIP Colonel Flanders, American Boys, The Painters, and The Night They Raided Rimsky's.

programme.title: Ken Berry, Totie Fields
programme.desc: Guest stars Ken Berry and Totie Fields drop by to take part in some of Carol's most popular recurring sketches.

programme.title: Jack Klugman
programme.desc: Jack Klugman is tonight's guest star; Jack plays a skeptical man annoyed by his sister-in-law's visiting date: a clairvoyant; Carol, Tim and Harvey get a little work done in a very tiny office.

programme.title: Ronnie Schell, Nancy Wilson
programme.desc: Ronnie Schell and Nancy Wilson.

programme.title: Frank Gorshin, Lana Turner
programme.desc: Carol's guests are Frank Gorshin and Lana Turner; Gorshin does his famous impressions, then joins up with Turner in a sketch about Bluebeard, who has just taken his unlucky 13th bride, Carol.

programme.title: Ruth Buzzi and Jack Gilford
programme.desc: Ruth Buzzi and Jack Gilford make a guest appearance in the story of "Snow White: 15 Years Later"; a car accident leads to a misunderstanding on "Carol & Sis"; Carol and Vicki deal with censorship.

programme.title: Rock Hudson
programme.desc: Eunice and Mickey try to coax Mama out of her house and into a retirement home in "The Family"; a smooth operator attempts to pick up a sexpot in a bar; guest Rock Hudson.

programme.title: Alan King
programme.desc: A psychiatrist is bombarded by phone calls from his family; a salute to Warner Bros. with movie spoofs; the Old Man works as a repairman of musical instruments; guest Alan King.

programme.title: Steve Lawrence and Sally Struthers
programme.desc: Guests: Steve Lawrence; Sally Struthers.

programme.title: Roddy McDowell
programme.desc: Mr. Tudball gets into trouble with a door buzzer system and Mrs. Wiggins is no help; a filmmaker wreaks havoc in a hospital; a musical salute to silent movie comedians; guest Roddy McDowall.

programme.title: Kenneth Mars and John Byner
programme.desc: Kenneth Mars and John Byner guest star; sketches include Carol as an obsessed and oblivious soap opera fanatic, John enlisting Kenneth's coaching in a breakup, and the dreams of a married couple.

programme.title: Lily Tomlin, Steve Lawrence
programme.desc: Guest stars Lily Tomlin and Steve Lawrence; Lily plays a prison matron and performs a monologue; Steve plays a crime boss on his honeymoon, but is constantly interrupted by requests for favors.

programme.title: Ken Berry, Dionne Warwick
programme.desc: Guests: Ken Berry and Dionne Warwick.

programme.title: Jim Nabors, Dave Powers

programme.title: Tim Conway and Peggy Lee
programme.desc: Guests include Tim Conway and Peggy Lee.

programme.title: Shirley Jones, George Chakiris
programme.desc: Carol's guests are George Chakiris and Shirley Jones; Chakiris joins Carol for the Q&A; the latest Carol & Sis sketch finds Jones playing Roger's temp secretary.

programme.title: Ken Berry
programme.desc: Mr. Tudball has a hard time coordinating a fire-safety plan with Mrs. Wiggins; a soldier stranded in a desert with a commanding officer; a parody of 1930s Mickey Rooney/Judy Garland musicals; guest Ken Berry.

programme.title: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programme.desc: Featuring the original broadcast master collection of Carol's song-and-dance spoofs of TV or movie classics, including Hollywood guests like Steve Martin.

programme.title: Michele Lee, Flip Wilson, Vivian Blondell
programme.desc: Guests include Michele Lee, Flip Wilson and Vivian Blondell.

programme.title: Ethel Merman and Tim Conway
programme.desc: Guest Tim Conway plays a dentist; understudy Carol looks to steal the show from a Broadway star; Ethel Merman also guest stars.

programme.title: Barbara McNair, Sid Caesar

programme.desc: Charlie struggles to control his anger after meeting a hot girl who doesn't date angry guys; Jordan and Sean play some pranks on Charlie.

programme.title: Charlie Gets Trashed
programme.desc: Charlie looks for revenge after going to war with his garbage man; Nolan and Lacey compete for the same job.

programme.title: Charlie & The Case of the Curious Hottie
programme.desc: Charlie becomes paranoid after discovering he's dating a private investigator; Nolan and Lacey move into Nolan's work limo.

programme.title: Charlie Pledges a Sorority Sister
programme.desc: Charlie falls into trap when Jordan sets him up with a heartbreaker; Lacey begins dating a record producer.

programme.title: Charlie Plays Hide & Go Cheat
programme.desc: Charlie finds himself in a contest with a female private investigator to prove that he could cheat on her without getting caught.

programme.title: Charlie & The Revenge of the Hot Nerd
programme.desc: Charlie's life is taken hostage by a controlling techy girl; Lacey launches a plan with Patrick to trick her rival into having sex with Ed.

programme.title: Charlie & The Curse of the Flying Fist
programme.desc: Charlie creates a monster when he helps Nolan unleash his anger.

programme.title: Charlie & The Houseful of Hookers
programme.desc: Charlie lets his house become a halfway house for five hookers.

programme.title: Charlie Gets Patrick High
programme.desc: Charlie tries to help Patrick through a crisis of confidence by getting him stoned.

programme.title: Charlie and Lacey Go For Broke
programme.desc: Charlie accidentally causes Lacey to become engaged to a creepy billionaire (Gilbert Gottfried).

programme.title: Charlie & The Terrible, Horrible, No Good Very Bad Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Charlie almost destroys Ed's marriage and Jordan hits on Nolan.

programme.title: Charlie Rolls The Dice in Vegas
programme.desc: Charlie goes to Vegas and life gets complicated after a night of heavy drinking.

programme.title: Charlie & The Return of the Danger Girl
programme.desc: Charlie risks his life to sleep with a thrill-seeker.

programme.title: Charlie Gets in Bed with Jordan and Her Ex
programme.desc: Charlie gets between Jordan and her ex-husband.

programme.title: Charlie's Living the Dream
programme.desc: Charlie becomes trapped in a wild dream where he can't distinguish between what's real and what's not.

programme.title: Charlie Meets his Match
programme.desc: A matchmaker sets up Charlie and Sean with the wrong dates.

programme.title: Charlie and The Epic Relationship Fail
programme.desc: Charlie interferes with Lacey and Nolan's love life and gets Nolan kidnapped by prisoners.

programme.title: Charlie Gets Tied Up with A Catholic Girl
programme.desc: Charlie's father sets him up with a hot, but quiet Catholic girl who turns out to be too wild, even for Charlie.

programme.title: Charlie and the Sexy Swing Vote
programme.desc: Charlie's father sets him up with a hot, but quiet Catholic girl who turns out to be too wild, even for Charlie.

programme.title: Charlie & The 100th Episode
programme.desc: Charlie has to make a decision between keeping his group and being a sports psychologist for a baseball team.

programme.title: Charlie Goes Back to Therapy
programme.desc: The first episode in which Charlie - a baseball player with anger issues turned anger management therapist - decides to return to therapy after a bad run-in with his ex wife's new boyfriend. The only problem is he just happens to be sleeping with the one therapist he trusts: his best friend, Kate.

programme.title: Charlie & The Slumpbuster
programme.desc: The new "evolved" Charlie has to deal with a ghost from his old carousing, baseball-playing days when a unattractive woman he slept with just to break a batting slump shows up as a new patient in group therapy.

programme.title: Charlie and Kent Battle over a Patient
programme.desc: A long-standing rivalry over who's a better therapist leads to war when Kate steals Patrick, one of Charlie's group patients.

programme.title: Charlie Tries Sleep Deprivation
programme.desc: Charlie challenges his group to do thirty-six hours of sleep deprivation therapy so that their "inhibitions come down and the truth comes out" - except the result turns out to be the exact opposite.

programme.title: Charlie's Patient Gets Out of Jail
programme.desc: Charlie and his ex, Jennifer, are having an issue with how Charlie still tries to manage her life when Cleo - one of Charlie's patients from his prison anger therapy group - shows up on his doorstep, fresh out on parole. Jennifer decides to get back at Charlie by dating the ex-con.

programme.title: Charlie Dates Kate's Patient
programme.desc: Inflamed by Kate's comment that he's only "nouveau smart", Charlie starts covertly dating a brilliant coffee-shop barista. The only problem is that the woman is turned on by sex where there's a chance of getting caught -- and she's Kate's patient.

programme.title: Charlie Tries to Prove Therapy is Legit
programme.desc: Charlie falls for Jen's hot new business partner, Lori - played by Charlie's real-life ex, Denise Richards - only to find she thinks therapy is a scam. In the therapy group, Patrick asks Charlie to counsel the angry ghost of his mother, who he believes is haunting his apartment.

programme.title: Charlie Outs A Patient
programme.desc: Charlie has to evaluate the depth of his involvement in his patient's lives when he accidentally helps his patient who vicariously enjoys other people's anger hook up with a crazy woman.

programme.title: Charlie's Dad Visits
programme.desc: Charlie gets an unexpected visit from his hyper-critical, bullying father - played by Charlie's real-life dad, Martin Sheen. In the therapy group, Charlie attempts to help Lacey with road rage.

programme.title: Charlie Gets Romantic
programme.desc: After Charlie and Kate have sex, he innocently asks her if she wants to go to a movie. Kate interprets this as a romantic gesture, rushes to fix him up on a date the next day with someone else and the two are forced to exam the nature of their odd relationship. At home, Sam kisses a girl at school and a picture of it ends up on Facebook.

programme.title: Charlies Loses it at a Baby Shower
programme.desc: Charlie gets an invitation to his sister's baby shower and asks Kate to come along. Patrick decides to tell Ed that his daughter is gay.

programme.title: Charlie's Dad Starts to Lose It
programme.desc: Charlie believes his father is faking Alzheimer's, and uses a hidden camera to spy on him. Patrick offers to help Nolan change his appearance to help his self-esteem.

programme.title: Charlie and the Ex-Patient
programme.desc: Charlie begins a questionable romantic relationship with an ex-patient after the five-year mandatory waiting period runs out.

programme.title: Charlie's Dad Breaks Bad
programme.desc: Charlie tries to persuade his father to join a choir of people his own age, a decision he later regrets. Lacey helps Patrick as an anger ally while he deals with a bully from high school.

programme.title: Charlie & Jen Together Again
programme.desc: Jennifer moves in with Charlie temporarily and Kate gets jealous.

programme.title: Charlie and Deception Therapy
programme.desc: Charlie tries to help his patient, Ed (Barry Corbin), with a placebo pill that's supposedly reduces anger.

programme.title: Charlie Dates a Teacher
programme.desc: Charlie gets involved with Sam's English teacher, he thinks her bad grade is based on his poor sexual performance; Lacey starts to have illicit romantic dreams about both Kate and Charlie.

programme.title: Charlie and Cee Lo
programme.desc: Charlie runs into problems when CeeLo Green hires him as his personal therapist. Kate wants Charlie to drop CeeLo as a patient, because he is interrupting their time together.

programme.title: Charlie Is An Expert Witness
programme.desc: Charlie and Kate face off as expert witnesses in the same trial; Charlie gives Nolan homework to get in touch with his feelings.

programme.title: Charlie & Catholicism
programme.desc: Charlie and his dad (Martin Sheen) get into it when Martin has Charlie's daughter, Sam, baptized behind Charlie's back.

programme.title: Charlie Dates Crazy, Sexy, Angry
programme.desc: Charlie dates Jennifer's business partner and finds out she has sexual anger issues; the support group tries to find a rich boyfriend for Lacey.

programme.title: Charlie Gets Lindsay Lohan Into Trouble
programme.desc: Lindsay Lohan comes to Charlie for therapy, and they begin a tumultuous relationship that ends up getting her in trouble.

programme.title: Charlie and Lacey Piss Off the Neighborhood
programme.desc: Charlie's neighbors find out he's been having clients with anger issues meeting at his house; Kate goes with Jennifer to help find a dress for Sam.

programme.title: Charlie & Kate Horse Around
programme.desc: When Sam finds out that her favorite horse is in equine therapy, Charlie uses that as a bonding exercise for his group.

programme.title: Charlie's Patients Hook Up
programme.desc: Two patients in Charlie's group get involved in a romantic relationship.

programme.title: Charlie and Kate's Dirty Pictures
programme.desc: Charlie manages to persuade Kate to take Nolan on as her PA, but Nolan discovers more than Charlie would like to know. Meanwhile, Lacey is having problems in prison.

programme.title: Charlie Lets Kate Take Charge
programme.desc: Charlie lets his father help him coach a high school baseball team; Kate takes over Charlie's group during his coaching gig.

programme.title: Charlie & The Break-Up Coach
programme.desc: Jennifer causes problems for Charlie when she becomes involved with one of his patients

programme.title: Charlie, Kate and Jen Get Romantic
programme.desc: Martin tells Kate that Charlie and Jennifer are getting back together; Nolan helps Ed as his anger buddy.

programme.title: Charlie Breaks Up With Kate
programme.desc: Charlie shakes up his relationship with Kate while dealing with the return of Jen's ex-boyfriend; Charlie's group volunteers at a soup kitchen.

programme.title: Charlie and Kate Start a Sex Study
programme.desc: Charlie and Kate try to control their sexual urges as they begin work together on their sex study; Lacey starts a new job as a pharmaceutical rep.

programme.title: Charlie and His New Friend With Benefits
programme.desc: After his breakup, Charlie starts a friends-with-benefits relationship with a hot woman subject from the sex study.

programme.title: Charlie and the Airport Sext
programme.desc: Charlie's trip to Lake Tahoe with the group is interrupted when he gets some interesting news from Kate.

programme.title: Charlie and His New Therapist
programme.desc: Charlie meets with an unorthodox therapist. Later, Patrick tricks Ed into thinking he won the lottery.

programme.title: Charlie & The Hot Nerd
programme.desc: Charlie steals a hot woman from an angry nerd who finds a way to make his life a living hell; Lacey takes drugs.

programme.title: Charlie and the Secret Gigolo
programme.desc: Charlie learns scandalous information about Jen's new boyfriend, Sean, when he joins his therapy group. Also, Ed moves in with Patrick.

programme.title: Charlie Dates A Serial Killerʼs Sister
programme.desc: Charlie picks up a woman at prison, unaware that she is the sister of one of his most violent patients. Lacey secretly puts on a strip show for Nolan

programme.title: Charlie & The Cheating Patient
programme.desc: Charlie suspects Jen's boyfriend is cheating on her with his patient; Ed and Patrick help Nolan after his apartment gets robbed.

programme.title: Charlie and the Hit and Run
programme.desc: Charlie deals with the aftermath when Martin hits someone with his car. Later, Lacey takes Nolan out to a club.

programme.title: The Nazca Lines and Underground Channels
programme.desc: The Nazca and their accomplishments; the Nazca's irrigation system of underground aquifers, aqueducts and wells; polychrome pottery and textiles; the mystery of the Nazca Lines, which may be the result of ritual pilgrimage.

programme.title: Alexander the Great - Conqueror or Tyrant?
programme.desc: Pondering Alexander's identity and story; learning about the ancient sources that contribute to people's understanding of Alexander's life and legacy; examining the ways this figure is perceived by modern scholars.

programme.title: Greece in the Age of Hegemonies
programme.desc: The story of Alexander starts centuries before his birth, in the Greek city-states throughout the Aegean; the conflicts and political crises that shape the Greek world in the generations before Alexander; his father Philip's conquest of the region.

programme.title: Achaemenid Persia
programme.desc: The Persian Empire of the 4th century offers a fierce opponent to Alexander in his conquest; the history of this mighty empire in the two centuries before Alexander's rise; the political and administrative structures that contribute to its success.

programme.title: The World of Early Macedon
programme.desc: Although they ultimately unite Greece, Philip and Alexander are not considered full-fledged Greeks, learning about their barbarian homeland of Macedon and investigating its relationship to the more culturally influential city-states of Greece.

programme.title: Philip II and the Macedonian Way of War
programme.desc: In his victories, Alexander is indebted to his father, Philip II, for his remarkable innovations in warcraft; Philip's achievements, including his reorganization of the Macedonian army; a study of three decisive battles.

programme.title: The Third Sacred War
programme.desc: A turning point in Greek political history; the Third Sacred War, a conflict that pits major powers in Sparta and Thebes in a battle for dominance; the complicated negotiations in this conflict that lead to Philip's control of Delphi and the Aegean.

programme.title: The Macedonian Conquest of Greece
programme.desc: By 346 B.C., Philip of Macedon congratulates himself on some stunning victories; his greatest achievement is yet to come: the ingenious political and military maneuvers, the decisive Battle of Charonea, which gives Philip control of the Greek world.

programme.title: The League of Corinth
programme.desc: Philip's defeat of Greece is matched only by the diplomatically ingenious settlement of his newly conquered territories; the ruler's strategies for running his empire; one of his most impressive administrative projects; the League of Corinth.

programme.title: South America's Lost Cradle of Civilization
programme.desc: The evidence for South America as one of the true wellsprings of human civilization; the diversity of early South American cultures; what the cultures shared; innovations in agriculture, architecture, handicrafts, social organization and religion.

programme.title: Discovering Peru's Earliest Cities
programme.desc: The first cities in the Americas, dating back to 3000 B.C.; investigating the means of subsistence of coastal and inland valley cities; evidence of trade in marine and agricultural products; learning about the sites of Kotosh, El Paraíso and Caral.

programme.title: South America's First People

programme.title: Peperonata Pasta
programme.desc: Elevated pasta doesn't need to be complicated or expensive. Chef Frankie Celenza makes Peperonata Pasta with just 5 ingredients. Plus, how to properly store sauce for a future meal.

programme.title: Frozen Broccoli, Bechamel, Mac, and Cheese

programme.title: Can you say, Cassoulet!

programme.title: Bread Masters
programme.desc: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

programme.title: Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
programme.desc: Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

programme.title: Guayabera World
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: The Art of the Egg
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: The Famous Pastes of Spices
programme.desc: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Yucatán's Most Unique Salts
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: A Mayan League of their Own
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: A Day With Hugo
programme.desc: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Yucatán Meats
programme.desc: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
programme.desc: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: The Best Tacos In Mérida
programme.desc: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.title: Nazi Overlord
programme.desc: Against the background of the D-Day invasion, a US military unit must rescue a brilliant British scientist, who is held captive by the most dangerous SS guards, deep in enemy territory. The Allies' victory depends on the success of this mission.

programme.title: 2012: Doomsday
programme.desc: Four strangers on a journey of faith are drawn to a temple in the heart of Mexico on December 21, 2012. For the Mayans it is the last recorded day. For NASA scientists it is a cataclysmic polar shift. For the rest of us, it is Doomsday.

programme.title: Hold Your Breath
programme.desc: A group of friends on a roadtrip explore a cemetery where the ghost of a notorious serial killer jumps from body to body, killing his victims one by one.

programme.title: Escape from Altura
programme.desc: 10K nearly loses everything as Panic and anti-Talker sentiments flare after an explosion derails the vote.

programme.title: Insect
programme.desc: After ecological disaster causes the collapse of modern civilization, two sisters venture out from their fortified compound when their mother is severely wounded after scavenging bandits attempt to raid their home. The only advantage the sisters have is a super-charged armored muscle car.

programme.title: Ghosthunters
programme.desc: When one of their own loses his wife and daughter at the hands of a serial killer, a team of ghost hunters is determined to capture the spirits of the loved ones so their spirits can finally rest in peace. But as the team goes deeper into the house, the ghosts become more hostile, and the group discovers the true secrets of the house and its murderer.

programme.title: Alien Predator
programme.desc: A black ops reconnaissance team is sent to investigate the crash of an unidentified aircraft. There, they discover that they are being hunted by an alien expedition to Earth.

programme.title: 666: The Child
programme.desc: After a plane crash, where a boy is the only survivor, a childless couple adopts him and soon discovers he is something very powerful, something very dark. This small boy is the Beast, and with him, he carries the Beginning of the End.

programme.title: Almighty Thor
programme.desc: When the demon god Loki destroys the fortress of Valhalla and steals the Hammer of Invincibility, only the young hero Thor can protect Earth from armageddon.

programme.title: Philly Feast
programme.desc: Out to get Cassandra back, her bizarre and dangerous "family" of cannibals catches up with the team and kidnaps Addy, endangering the mission.

programme.title: Jungle Run
programme.desc: A search for their missing father turns deadly when sibling adventurers find themselves viciously attacked by jungle animals. But as they fight back against the relentless onslaught they start to realize something much more sinister may be behind the attacks.

programme.title: Zombie Road
programme.desc: Our Heroes manage to finally track Murphy down and are introduced to "Z-Weed," an ultra-potent strain of marijuana grown in zombie compost. They go on a quest for "Batch 47," a potential cure for the Zombie Virus.

programme.title: Ape vs. Mecha Ape
programme.desc: Recognizing the destructive power of the giant Ape, the military makes its own battle-ready, A.I. Mecha Ape. Its first practical test goes horribly wrong, leaving the military no choice but to release the imprisoned giant Ape to stop the robot.

programme.title: No Mercy: Part 1
programme.desc: In this "FLASHBACK MOVIE," the old crew meet a feral kid who leads them to Mercy Laboratories, a mysterious compound of survivors awaiting the return of "The Man," a villain of the Apocalypse who carries around a list of soon-to-disappear people.

programme.title: Ardennes Fury
programme.desc: As the Battle of the Bulge rages on, an American tank unit gets trapped behind Nazi lines. With just hours before the bombs of Operation Ardennes Fury fall, the tank's commander makes the risky decision to rescue an orphanage.

programme.title: Street Racer
programme.desc: After recovering from a tragic accident, a former street racer struggles to redeem himself and join the elite racing world.

programme.title: 24 Hours to D-Day
programme.desc: Just hours before D-Day, American Special Forces are tasked with parachuting in the dead of night into German-con- trolled France to guide the 101st Airborne assault ahead of the landings at Normandy. They must work together, avoid German capture, and get location and drop zone beacons on all before the Allied invasion of France begins.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Crocosaurus
programme.desc: The massive prehistoric shark has survived the last battle, and the world is again threatened when a new, more dangerous foe is discovered in the jungles of Africa.

programme.title: Shapeshifter
programme.desc: Inmates and guards alike become trapped in a maximum security prison when they fall prey to a demonic beast that feeds on human flesh.

programme.title: Zoombies
programme.desc: When a strange virus quickly spreads through a safari park and turns all the zoo animals undead, those left in the park must stop the creatures before they escape and zombify the whole city.

programme.title: Social Nightmare
programme.desc: An A-student's life is turned upside-down when inappropriate status updates and photos appear on her online profile. Soon, she learns that even her life is in danger.

programme.title: Doc's Stoned History
programme.desc: Skeezy and Sketchy re-enact Doc's stories of the Founding Fathers. Warren and the others search for the bizkit bakery and the secret ingredient in them.

programme.title: Corporate Retreat
programme.desc: Our Heroes find themselves with a group of white-collar survivors and someone tries to kill Murphy. Suddenly faced with a possible killer in their midst, our Heroes play a dangerous game of "Clue"-with zombies!

programme.title: Devil's Triangle
programme.desc: When a group of marine biologists crash land in the Bermuda Triangle, they realize they have stumbled into the lost city of Atlantis. But they quickly discover the city isn't friendly, and its humanoid inhabitants are planning worldwide domination using the piles of weapons and technology that have fallen through the Triangle over the centuries.

programme.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
programme.desc: Due to a scientific experiment gone awry, a research team ends up in a strange land below the earth's crust. There they must fend off a series of strange creatures, including vicious dinosaurs and spiders. Meanwhile, above ground, Emily Radford helps military official Joseph Harnet with his plan to save the stranded research team. Their strategy is to use a high-powered drill to bore their way to the researchers, one of whom is Emily's sister.

programme.title: Invasion of the Pod People
programme.desc: After a woman's closest friends and co-workers undergo extreme personality changes, she begins to suspect that they have been replaced by malevolent alien invaders.

programme.title: Super Cyclone
programme.desc: When a super cyclone threatens the entire American eastern seaboard, a lone meteorologist and a petroleum engineer must battle the elements to stop the threat.

programme.title: No Mercy: Part 2
programme.desc: In this "FLASHBACK MOVIE," the old crew meet a feral kid who leads them to Mercy Laboratories, a mysterious compound of survivors awaiting the return of "The Man," a villain of the Apocalypse who carries around a list of soon-to-disappear people.

programme.title: The Day the Earth Stopped
programme.desc: Hundreds of massive intergalactic robots appear in all of the major world capitals with an ultimatum: Prove the value of human civilization or be destroyed.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: Murphy is captured by an overly enthusiastic and slightly unbalanced zombie fan, "The Collector." Murphy must match wits with the Collector if he's to survive, much less escape.

programme.title: The Terminators
programme.desc: In the near future, people utilize cyborgs for labor, but the vastly intelligent robots rebel against their masters and begin to take over human civilization through mass destruction. A small group of survivors, led by Sheriff Reed Carpenter (A Martinez), plans to stop the cyborgs, tapping inventor Kurt Ross (Jeremy London) for help. Using a space shuttle designed by Ross, Carpenter and his team head for a control center in outer space that has the power to shut down the machines.

programme.title: Transmorphers
programme.desc: A race of alien robots has conquered the Earth and forced humanity underground. After three hundred years of domination, a small group of humans develop a plan to defeat the mechanical invaders in the ultimate battle between man and machine.

programme.title: Meteor Moon
programme.desc: When a meteor crashes into the moon and shifts its axis, Earth's gravity pulls the moon into the path of the planet. Now, a group of scientists must figure out how to stop the moon from hitting the earth before it's too late.

programme.title: 3 Musketeers
programme.desc: Alexandra D'Artagnan, junior NSA officer, uncovers a plot to assasinate the President of the United States and enlists the help of three infamous international spies to stop the threat.

programme.title: In a New York Minute
programme.desc: Kourtney gets the opportunity of a lifetime when she's offered a role on 'One Life To Live'. Kim must decide between attending Scott's work event or obeying her mother's commands.

programme.title: One Last Dash
programme.desc: Kim considers moving to New York City; Scott buys a ring for Kourtney and contemplates marriage.

programme.title: Trouble in Paradise
programme.desc: Kourtney, Khloé, and Scott have arrived in the Hamptons; Scott has anxiety about being in his late parents' hometown; Khloé sets off on a romantic getaway to South Africa with her new boyfriend.

programme.title: What's That Racquet?
programme.desc: After Kourtney tells Scott off for breaking the boundaries they've set for their relationship, Scott tries to get back in her good graces.

programme.title: Party Crashing
programme.desc: Kourtney flies to LA to confront Kim for using her home for North's birthday party without her permission; Scott finds himself in the hospital after excessive partying.

programme.title: 12 Steps and 30 Candles
programme.desc: Scott finally makes the decision to check into rehab, but his commitment to stay wavers with each day; Khloé struggles with the realization that her life isn't where she imagined it would be as her 30th birthday gets closer.

programme.title: Aftershocks
programme.desc: Kourtney and Scott try to steer clear of repeating their past mistakes; Kim start to doubt her best friend's loyalty when family secrets are leaked to the media.

programme.title: Kaptain Kourtney and Skipper Scott
programme.desc: Khloé arranges for her and Scott to host a podcast together, taking her support of Scott to another level; Kourtney declares that she is a trained sailor, Khloé and Scott elect to test her skills on the open water.

programme.title: A House Divided

programme.title: Best Friends With Benefits
programme.desc: When Khloé enjoys a night of drinking, Kourtney gets angry and accuses her of recklessly putting Scott's sobriety in jeopardy; after Malika drunkenly kisses Khloé, Khloé starts to question what their friendship really means.

programme.desc: Kim and Kris join Kourtney and Scott in New York City, but things don't run as smoothly as planned.

programme.title: Go Get Your Man

programme.title: Questionable Actions

programme.title: Cats Away, Mice Play
programme.desc: Kourtney and Kim go to Mystic, Connecticut while the boys sneak off to Toronto and get in some trouble.

programme.title: Kim Takes Dubai

programme.title: Family Therapy
programme.desc: Kim takes her relationship frustrations out on her family; Khloe tries to help Scott and Kourt with their sleeping arrangements.

programme.title: Voices From Beyond

programme.title: Goodbye, New York
programme.desc: The couples say goodbye to New York; Kim makes a decision about her marriage.

programme.title: When It Rains, It Pours

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Cold Blood
