programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Her Alibi
programme.desc: Mystery novelist Phil Blackwood has written countless bestsellers, but he's having trouble finding inspiration for his latest book, so he goes to the courthouse to observe real criminals in action. There he encounters Nina, a gorgeous immigrant charged with a gruesome murder. Convinced she's not guilty, Phil furnishes Nina with an alibi and a place to stay. But, as the two begin to fall in love, Phil finds he has grave doubts about her innocence.

programme.title: Little Children
programme.desc: A small town hides a sordid underbelly of adultery and perversion.

programme.title: The Accidental Tourist
programme.desc: A travel writer hates to travel and loves order, until everything changes.

programme.title: Red Sonja
programme.desc: Power-hungry Queen Gedren (Sandahl Bergman) captures the priestesses guarding the Talisman, a mystical orb that created and can destroy the world. But one of the priestesses escapes and seeks out her warrior sister, Red Sonja (Brigitte Nielsen), to warn her about Gedren's plan for world domination. Lord Kalidor (Arnold Schwarzenegger), the Talisman's keeper, insists on helping Sonja, and though she scorns the assistance of any man, she soon gains respect for Kalidor's fighting prowess.

programme.title: I Am Sam
programme.desc: A man with an intellectual disability fights for custody of his daughter.

programme.title: Arthur 2: On the Rocks
programme.desc: The world's richest and most tipsy wit, is alive, well and living in style!

programme.title: Alex & Emma
programme.desc: An author with a case of writer's block hires a stenographer to help him.

programme.title: Love Affair
programme.desc: Two star-crossed lovers vow to meet again if they still love each other.

programme.title: The Right Stuff
programme.desc: NASA recruits seven test pilots for the Mercury Space Program.

programme.title: Ghosts of Mississippi
programme.desc: A district attorney reopens the case against the murderer of Medgar Evers.

programme.title: Message in a Bottle
programme.desc: A lonely woman's discovery of a man's letter in a bottle leads to love.

programme.title: The Prince of Pennsylvania
programme.desc: A teen develops an unlikely friendship with a hippie who runs a drive-in.

programme.title: Collateral Damage
programme.desc: Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as a man on a mission of vengeance.

programme.title: Chariots of Fire
programme.desc: In the class-obsessed and religiously divided United Kingdom of the early 1920s, two determined young runners train for the 1924 Paris Olympics. Eric Liddell (Ian Charleson), a devout Christian born to Scottish missionaries in China, sees running as part of his worship of God's glory and refuses to train or compete on the Sabbath. Harold Abrahams (Ben Cross) overcomes anti-Semitism and class bias, but neglects his beloved sweetheart Sybil (Alice Krige) in his single-minded quest.

programme.title: Almost Heroes
programme.desc: Two explorers are racing Lewis and Clark to the Pacific Ocean in 1804. Edwards (Matthew Perry) is a glory-seeking fop who's out of his league, Hunt (Chris Farley) is a slovenly, clumsy tracker with a soft spot for toilet humor. Along with a team of misfits and losers, the duo wreaks havoc on the American frontier.

programme.title: The Spitfire Grill
programme.desc: Percy looks to start over in a quiet town by taking a job at a local cafe.

programme.title: Best Friends
programme.desc: A couple learns the differences between being married rather than friends.

programme.title: Lost in Space
programme.desc: The Robinsons are selected to be the first family to colonize outer space.

programme.title: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Dylan Ramsey (David Spade) is getting ready to open his own restaurant, but he's become preoccupied his new neighbor, a gorgeous Frenchwoman named Lila (Sophie Marceau). When Dylan doesn't have much luck talking to her, he decides that the way to her heart may be through her beloved dog, Jack. Abducting the canine, Dylan hopes to win Lila's affection when he returns Jack safe and sound, but soon the scheming guy has to deal with numerous unforeseen problems that jeopardize his plan.

programme.title: Club Paradise
programme.desc: A Chicago fireman holds onto his dream of owning a tropical island resort.

programme.title: Joe Versus the Volcano
programme.desc: Joe Banks (Tom Hanks) is dying, apparently. This is good news, since his life was not much worth living anyway. On the upside, a strange millionaire (Lloyd Bridges) offers Joe a way to die with meaning and dignity: by hurling himself into a volcano. With plenty of spending cash and an ensemble of new luggage, Joe embarks on an absurdist journey to his demise, guided by two very disparate sisters, and trying to puzzle out the meaning of existence.

programme.title: One Crazy Summer
programme.desc: After graduating from high school, art school hopeful Hoops McCann (John Cusack) struggles to complete his application to the Rhode Island School of Design. Resigning himself to a summer of boredom, McCann agrees to go along with his best friend, George Calamari (Joel Murray), on a family trip to Nantucket, Mass. But, after McCann and Calamari meet rocker-in-distress Cassandra (Demi Moore), it suddenly looks like it's going to be "one crazy summer."

programme.title: The Hudsucker Proxy
programme.desc: Greedy executive Sidney J. Mussburger (Paul Newman) hopes to take control of the company he works for by purchasing a majority share -- but he must first devalue the stock. So he convinces the board to appoint know-nothing recent graduate Norville Barnes (Tim Robbins). But Mussburger's plot backfires when Barnes' latest invention succeeds, thereby increasing the company's value. Worse yet, undercover reporter Amy Archer (Jennifer Jason Leigh) has the scoop on Mussburger's shady dealings.

programme.title: Special Delivery
programme.desc: Nash must protect Lynette from Asian mobsters when she unknowingly becomes involved in a forgery ring; Joe's father visits.

programme.title: Touchdown
programme.desc: Several armored cars and their drivers disappear; a football star needs to find "the most beautiful girl in the world"; Nick is reluctant to use a hearing aid.

programme.title: Sacraments
programme.desc: Metal heads go on a crime spree; Nash learns of Cassidy and Evan's relationship; Nick gets an overdue Navy Cross.

programme.title: High Fall
programme.desc: Nash's ex-lover masterminds a real estate scam that leaves him destitute; Joe destroys his own home while trying to improve it.

programme.title: Impostors
programme.desc: Nash and Joe pose as gay detectives in San Francisco's Castro district while trying to find a Cher impersonator's stolen wig.

programme.title: Hot Prowler
programme.desc: Nash and Joe search for a psychopath who telecasts videotapes of his crimes on the Internet; Joe considers suing a restaurant.

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: Nash and Joe scramble to find enough evidence to prove the innocence of a man on death row; a parent sues Joe, claiming his daughter is mistreating his son in preschool.

programme.title: Apocalypse Nash
programme.desc: Nash and Joe share a jail cell while awaiting trial over the murder of three fellow police officers during a drug bust.

programme.title: The Tourist
programme.desc: Nash's ex-wife arrives from Paris and informs him that a bureaucratic snafu fouled up their divorce 12 years earlier.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: Nash and Caitlin pose as a married couple while investigating wife-swapping parties; Joe helps steal a corpse.

programme.title: Warplay
programme.desc: Wealthy businessmen play a bizarre war game that leads to deadly consequences; Evan's lover is the assistant district attorney's fiancée.

programme.title: Firestorm
programme.desc: Nash's mysterious friend helps in the search for a murderous arsonist; Joe tries to throw a surprise party for Nash.

programme.title: Hardball
programme.desc: Nash and Joe attempt to prevent a zealous INS agent from deporting a baseball star who is in the country illegally.

programme.title: Mystery Dance
programme.desc: Caitlin reveals details about her past to Nash; Joe battles a strict exercise and diet program; Cassidy and Nick team up for a tango competition.

programme.title: Shoot the Moon
programme.desc: Caitlin accidentally shoots Nash in the posterior; his pompous nemesis (Daniel Roebuck) replaces him.

programme.title: Gimme Shelter
programme.desc: While Nash pursues a gang of teenage carjackers, Joe goes undercover at a department store to catch a thief.

programme.title: Superstition
programme.desc: Nash must protect a young singer from obsessed fans intent on kidnapping her; Joe's attempt to buy his wife a car at a police auction backfires.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: Nash's daughter faces death after a car crash; a sniper is loose in the city; Joe battles rats; guest Dee Wallace Stone.

programme.title: Pump Action
programme.desc: An undercover police officer joins forces with Nash to put a choke hold on marauding bodybuilders who are pumped up on illegal steroids.

programme.title: Hide and Seek
programme.desc: Nash and Joe try to find the governor of California after he slips out of sight, fearing the exposure of a possible sex scandal involving his mistress.

programme.title: Boomtown
programme.desc: Nash and Joe search for a serial bomber; Cassidy must perform topless in her new play while her father is in the audience; Nick befriends a noisy band.

programme.title: Angel of Mercy
programme.desc: Nash and Joe search for a serial killer; Caitlin and Joe coach girls' soccer teams; Harvey reconciles with his estranged wife.

programme.title: Power Play
programme.desc: Nash and Joe must cure an amnesiac to rescue a man from the Russian mob; Joe undergoes fertility tests.

programme.title: Vendetta
programme.desc: Nash must protect Caitlin after she is portrayed as a kinky sex addict on the Internet by a former cop who she helped send to jail for wife beating.

programme.title: Crash and Burn
programme.desc: A series of robberies leads Nash and Joe to a group of women whose husbands are imprisoned for similar heists.

programme.title: Frisco Blues
programme.desc: Internal affairs demotes Nash and Joe to walking a beat; Cortez becomes a traffic officer; Leek goes to homicide; Caitlin works vice detail.

programme.title: Goodbye Kiss
programme.desc: The unit faces permanent closure; Caitlin plans to leave; Nash and Jake Cage (Steve Austin) compete for Caitlin.

programme.title: Truth and Consequences
programme.desc: The team searches for an actress's assassin; Caitlin moves in with Nash; Inger wants Joe to go to Sweden.

programme.title: Trade Off
programme.desc: Nash must save an 8-year-old child who has been kidnapped; kidnappers mistakenly take a boy whose parents have no money.

programme.title: Smash and Grab
programme.desc: Thieves pose as firefighters responding to jewelry store fires only to steal the goods; the unit must uncover a litigious in-line skater's insurance scam.

programme.title: Girl Trouble
programme.desc: Nash must save Cassidy from drug dealers who mistake her for another woman; Joe meets the person he has been flirting with online.

programme.title: High Society
programme.desc: Nash and Caitlin ask Jake Cage (Steve Austin) to help identify a dangerous fugitive at a posh wedding.

programme.title: Curveball
programme.desc: Nash and the team must track down a corrupt official who plans to leave the country with $5 million in pension funds; Caitlin accidentally throws one of Nash's prized possessions through a window.

programme.title: Split Decision
programme.desc: An ex-con claims to suffer from multiple personalities when he is caught robbing banks; Nick moves to a high-class retirement home; Harvey confronts Evan about his substance abuse.

programme.title: Get Bananas
programme.desc: Nash and Joe must protect a famous chimpanzee from animal rights activists wishing to release him into the jungle; Jake Cage searches for a wanted murderer; Evan pursues a drug dealer without Nash's approval.

programme.title: Crosstalk
programme.desc: Nash tracks a paranoid, delusional man who randomly kills cell-phone users; Nash and Joe investigate the decapitation of a dummy; Joe's dreams about Caitlin interfere with his waking hours.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: Nash and the team track down a vigilante intent on bringing murderers to justice; Caitlin and Joe form a partnership to deliver doughnuts via the Internet.

programme.title: Rip Off
programme.desc: The team must track down two gangs of robbers, one of which has an informant in its ranks who is tipping off the rival one.

programme.title: Skin Trade
programme.desc: Caitlin is undercover as a madam to stop a pornography and sex-slavery ring; Nash calls Caitlin by his ex-wife's name.

programme.title: Liar's Poker
programme.desc: Nash is undercover as a favor to an FBI agent; Inger and Lucia return from Sweden; Nick's poker buddies get him in trouble.

programme.title: El Diablo
programme.desc: While Nash investigates the death of a woman who plunged off a balcony, Joe gives Evan a second chance to redeem himself.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: Nash and Joe's client is killed when the building in which they are meeting explodes; Joe's mother-in-law and Nick fall in love.

programme.title: Cop Out
programme.desc: Nash must catch a man who dons a police uniform and terrorizes people; Nash and Caitlin must learn to get along during work; Nick wants his driver's license.

programme.title: Line of Sight
programme.desc: A drug dealer tries to corner the market by killing his competition; Evan and Cassidy discover they are being stalked when they begin dating again.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: Nash must infiltrate a thief's base of operation in order to catch him; Joe protects a mean-spirited restaurant critic; Evan returns to the unit; Caitlin may become Nash's boss.

programme.title: Hard Cell
programme.desc: Nash must help a convict in exchange for valuable information; Joe has a hard time with a delivery boy.

programme.title: Missing Key
programme.desc: Joe is the target for murder when a woman plants a key with him; Nick performs in Cassidy's play; Harvey is involved with a complicated woman.

programme.title: Jackpot
programme.desc: A police chief is murdered, and Jake Cage (Steve Austin) returns to assist Nash in the investigation.

programme.title: Jackpot
programme.desc: Nash is undercover in Las Vegas to stop an Asian kingpin; Evan is shot in the line of duty; Cassidy goes to the police academy.

programme.title: Rock and a Hard Place
programme.desc: Soon after Nash's daughter, Cassidy, joins the Special Investigation Unit, an escaped felon convicted with tainted evidence kidnaps her and Joe.

programme.title: Jump Start
programme.desc: Nash flips when he finds out that Cassidy played a hooker to nab a South African diamond smuggler; a new investigator joins the force.

programme.title: Lap Dance
programme.desc: Nash gets more than just a favor from a former lover when trying to take down a criminal with stolen cruise-missile secrets.

programme.title: Land Pirates
programme.desc: Nash and Joe are hot on the trail of a clever ring of thieves that preys on San Francisco's elite; Nash discovers the secret behind a nun's double life.

programme.title: ManHunt
programme.desc: A drug gang knocks over a DEA evidence warehouse and proves elusive for the members of the team; Antwon has a seizure while chasing down the leader of the gang.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Nash and Joe (Don Johnson, Cheech Marin) find out that someone has been "borrowing" the name of their detective agency. Guest stars: Jenna Lewis, Joel Klug, Sean Kenniff and Gervase Peterson of "Survivor."

Over the course of three decades, Cecil has a front-row seat to history and the inner workings of the Oval Office. However, his commitment to his "First Family" leads to tension at home, alienating his wife (Oprah Winfrey) and causing conflict with his anti-establishment son.

programme.title: Crime and Punishment
programme.desc: Barnaby learns how far some people will go for power when he investigates the death of a member of the Bleakridge Watch in the most remote village in Midsomer.

programme.title: Last Man Out
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter investigate the death of a star cricketer during a tournament, but could the dislike of a cricket format really be the motive for murder, or is there more at play.

programme.title: Red in Tooth and Claw
programme.desc: When Barnaby and Winter find a dead body covered in live rabbits, a sinister side to the local pet show is revealed. Is this a case of rivalry taken too far?

programme.title: Death by Persuasion
programme.desc: When a young woman slips away from a camp site where a Jane Austen fantasy event is taking place dressed in period attire, and is found stabbed in the woods with a quill, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter discover that the victim was a journalist interested in the village's healthcare drone delivery programme, and are forced to look back in time to find the killer.

programme.title: The Curse of the Ninth
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter uncover multiple motives when the winner of a fought-after music award is found strangled with a violin string moments before a performance, including a rivalry over the prize and a missing Stradivarius.

programme.title: Things That Go Bump in the Night
programme.desc: Barnaby and Scott travel to a picturesque village to investigate the murder of an undertaker. There, they discover that the village is divided by the presence of a spiritualist church run by a medium.

programme.title: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: The annual Midsomer Regatta is brought to a standstill when a body is found in the river. It turns out to be that of a noted ladies' man who had been previously seen arguing with friends. As Barnaby and Scott dig into the luxury lifestyles of the rowing set, they discover that money problems and sexual jealousy are rife.

programme.title: Orchis Fatalis
programme.desc: When one of the world's rarest orchids is smuggled illegally into Midsomer Malham, it triggers a catalogue of passion, jealousy and death. Barnaby and Troy must find both the flower and the person prepared to commit murder in order to get their hands on it.

programme.title: Bantling Boy
programme.desc: Barnaby and Scott enter the world of horse racing when the trainer of thoroughbred Bantling Boy is battered to death. Bruce Hartley was an alcoholic who had vowed to expose the reason why his father bequeathed the horse to four Midsomer villagers. The other members of the syndicate come under suspicion, but the killing continues - then Bantling Boy falls ill.

programme.title: Second Sight
programme.desc: Barnaby and Scott investigate a death in Midsomer Mere, where the villagers appear to be able to predict the future. As the investigation continues, further deaths occur and Barnaby must delve into the village's history for clues to solve the murders.

programme.title: Hidden Depths
programme.desc: When a solicitor falls from a roof to his death, Barnaby and Scott investigate whether it was suicide or murder. They discover that a rival lawyer was spreading harmful rumours about the dead man, but when this man is drugged and killed as well, the motive looks like revenge - but for what?

programme.title: Sauce for the Goose
programme.desc: Barnaby and Scott delve into the murder of a visitor to Plummer's Relish factory, and discover that the dead man was employed by a rival company. Further investigation reveals a web of secrets and lies within the Plummer family, and a campaign to frighten the family matriarch - but why?

programme.title: Midsomer Rhapsody
programme.desc: When retired music teacher Arthur Leggott is battered to death at his cottage, an unpublished musical score by the late Joan Alder, famous composer of 'Midsomer Rhapsody', is unearthed.

programme.title: The Christmas Haunting
programme.desc: It may be Christmas, but Charlie is given no time to familiarise himself with his new surroundings. He finds himself thrown straight into an intriguing mystery in the village of Morton Shallows, as furniture maker and serial philanderer Conor Bridgeman is stabbed to death with an antique sword during a ghost-hunting party at the manor house.

programme.title: Let Us Prey
programme.desc: Barnaby and Nelson investigate a series of murders in Midsomer St Claire. The crimes appear to be inspired by the macabre images on a medieval fresco recently discovered in the church crypt.

programme.title: Wild Harvest
programme.desc: When wealthy farmer Martin Strickland is covered in truffle oil and mauled to death by a wild boar, the investigation leads to restaurant Wyvern House and its tyrannical celebrity chef Ruth Cameron.

programme.title: The Flying Club
programme.desc: The owner of Finchmere Airfield drops dead from a plane. Astonished, Barnaby and Nelson enter the world of stunt pilots and aviation heroes, and discover a web of lies and intrigue.

programme.title: The Killings of Copenhagen
programme.desc: When the boss of Calder's Biscuit Company is murdered in Copenhagen, Barnaby and Nelson join forces with two female Danish detectives, the abrasive and astute Poulsen and the charming and cool Degn, and they discover Eric Calder had more linking him to Copenhagen than just his famous Golden Clusters.

programme.title: The Point of Balance
programme.desc: Midsomer is buzzing with excitement at the arrival of the annual Paramount Dance Extravaganza. Behind the sequins and smiles are deep running feuds and passions, and when the stakes are high, the desire to win has outweighed everything.

programme.title: The Miniature Murders
programme.desc: The worlds of miniature doll's houses and real houses collide when prolific real estate agent Alexander Beauvoisin is murdered in front of a crowd at the unveiling of a new doll's house collection at Midsomer Museum of the family.

programme.title: The Sting of Death
programme.desc: The Deddington's thriving bee empire has put Granville Norton on the map, but the lengths they will go to ensure they're never dethroned are extreme.

programme.title: With Baited Breath
programme.desc: Fishermen and women flock to the village of Solomon Gorge, desperate to catch a giant fish that is said to be in the lake. Their plans are threatened however when hundreds of Lycra-clad sporting enthusiasts descend on the area for the Psycho Mud Run.

programme.title: Garden of Death
programme.desc: When a family decide to turn Midsomer Deverell's Memorial Garden into a tea shop they dig up more than just the animosity of local villagers. Warring families, illegitimacy, sexual liaisons and a potent home brew confront Detective Chief Inspector Tom Barnaby as he investigates murder in the garden.

programme.title: Destroying Angel
programme.desc: Barnaby and Troy are dragged into a bizarre murder case at the Easterly Grange Hotel after a dog appears carrying a man's disembodied hand in its mouth.

programme.title: The Electric Vendetta
programme.desc: When a man's naked body is found at the centre of a crop circle and more corpses begin turning up with peculiar injuries, DCI Barnaby has to uncover who is responsible - or are extraterrestrial powers really at work in Midsomer?

programme.title: Who Killed Cock Robin?
programme.desc: The disappearance of a villager brings DCI Tom Barnaby face to face with old adversary Melvyn Stockard, now reinvented as the local squire. When a body is pulled out of a well, Barnaby is convinced Stockard is somehow involved.

programme.title: Dark Autumn
programme.desc: When a village postman is brutally murdered, DCI Barnaby uncovers a hotbed of adultery within the remote hamlet of Goodman's Land. As more murders rock the community, WPC Nash attempts to untangle the web of sexual liaisons in a bid to catch the killer.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub the Movie
programme.desc: A ronin Hai Itto (Manya Kinnosuke) is an assassin who travels with his son Daigoro (Okada Jizo) in a baby carriage. Itto is asked by the vassals of the Maruoka clan, whose feudal lord has been assassinated and the clan destroyed, to kill their underling, the official assassin Gunpei Yagyu (Katsuhiko Watahiki). Gunbei is the son of Retsudo Yagyu (Rentaro Mikuni), the chieftain of the Yagyu underlings.

programme.title: The Shaolin Kids
programme.desc: When a ruthless Premier Hu Wei Yung, writes a self-incriminating letter that ends up in the wrong hands (the delicate but deadly hands of the lovely Su Lin), he will stop at nothing to get it back. Premier kidnaps Miss Lin's father and she risks everything to free him.

programme.title: Kickboxer King
programme.desc: From the team that brought you "Ong Bak".Two kickboxers, Joe and Johnny, battle it out for supremacy, against a backdrop of gang violence, drug abuse and police corruption. Who will emerge victorious, and at what price?

programme.title: 52 Masters: SHUKOKAI KARATE with Ed Smith
programme.desc: Sensei Ed Smith trains Will in the secret art of power punching.

programme.title: 52 Masters: KOBAYASHI SHORIN-RYU with Marques McCammon
programme.desc: Will studies under Sensei Marques McCammon.

programme.title: Dance of Death
programme.desc: Kung fu girl, Angela Mao tricks two equally matched kung fu masters who duel every five years into teaching her both of their styles so she can take revenge against a vicious gang that killed her friends. The teachers stand by during her fights and count the number of moves that she uses to defeat her enemies so they can prove which of them is superior. This is one of the best choreographed Angela Mao movies, and is recommended for viewing by all Angela Mao fans.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 21
programme.desc: Through a series of manipulations and deceit, an evil mastermind causes a rift between the three for the extended season finale.

programme.title: Ninja Condors 13
programme.desc: Top Ninja Alexander Lo stars in this action packed ninja fest as a member of an evil gang of 13 ninjas. However, he wants to leave the gang and live a peaceful life, but the only way to exit the gang is by death.

programme.title: Dragon and Snake in the Spider's Web
programme.desc: Security Officer Lu (Tan Tao Liang) is following a case of a mysterious gun smuggler. His investigations lead him to Madam Wu, who appears to be the link between smuggler and client. Luckily for Lu, Wu seems to have a soft spot for the womanizing gambler known as Chang (Wong Tao) so Lu arrests him in the hope that, with a little brute force, he will assist in the case.

programme.title: Mystery of Chess Boxing
programme.desc: Lee Yi Min stars as a young boy, Ah Pao, who wants to learn kung fu so that he can avenge his father's death at the hands of the Ghost Faced Killer (Mark Long). The Ghost Faced Killer, meanwhile is hunting down a number of clan leaders who all conspired to have him killed. Before attacking, the killer always throws down his "ghost face killing plate," a decorated metal plate with a red face. He then uses his distinctive five elements style.

programme.title: Mantis Fists and Tiger Claws of Shaolin
programme.desc: When the local thugs harass a restaurant owner's daughter Shuang Shuang (Choi Chuk-Guen), a newcomer Pai (John Cheung) fends them off. When Pai goes off to the local brothel to find his long lost sister, the thugs rape Shuang Shuang, but get killed mysteriously later in the woods. The father of the thugs, Hung Chun Piao (Dean Shek), believes that Pai committed the murders and confronts him..

programme.title: The Ninja Showdown
programme.desc: A poor, young fighter Tony witnesses the injustices caused by the Purple Ninjas and vows to train to become as skilled as them to one day defeat them in battle. Help is at hand from Ninja Gordon, who gives him the necessary skills since he himself is on a mission to eliminate the Purple Ninjas. Will both fighters get what they have lost and cut off the evil ninjas purple heads?

programme.title: Golden Showdown
programme.desc: You'll know them when you see them! Returning to his home town and finding it overrun with ruthless gangsters led by Mr Chore, Richard sets out to stop their nefarious activities. A bloody conflict ensues, and when Richard's father is killed in retaliation he finds out that the law is no better. But then his sister is killed and Richard finally snaps, taking on the gang single-handedly and loaded to the very last bullet.

programme.title: Deadly Strike
programme.desc: The new police chief (Bruce Li) arrives in a small provincial town. He's been charged with bringing a dangerous gang to justice. But within seconds, the chief provokes a showdown with his lazy deputies. Realizing that they are not up to the job, he enlists the help of some of his prisoners, offering pardon to those who survive the encounter with the gang.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Episode 4
programme.desc: Hatsuuchi Suzuki, an official of the Tateyama Clan's Edo residence, attacked the axe-suke of Oshu, an Orizuke, and was beaten to death in a vicious revenge attack. Ittou, however, arrived a day too late. Itto met Hatsuuchi's children, Aya and Soichiro, who appealed to him for revenge. Itto slays Rikuzo in the gambling hall, Abukuma while eating, and Asuke who was with a woman, one after another. When he kills Asuke, he tells the woman who was with him: "If you are asked, you must answer.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub The Final: Episode 7
programme.desc: The bounty is at stake, and Hai Itto and Daigoro are declared publicly wanted criminals. The bounty hunters are always flocking to the scene, eager to get their hands on the 1,000 ryo bounty.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 7
programme.desc: The lone wolf made a promise to a dying undercover Yagyu ninja, to bring his wife to be together with him in the afterlife. This promise led Itto to a village with only women, whose sole purpose is to give birth to new ninjas.

programme.title: Born a Ninja
programme.desc: A Japanese scientist tries to conceal a deadly formula, but an undead ace and his ninja devils are determined to use it to cause mischief and mayhem. It is up to Lung, a master of the lost art of Hocus Pocus, to keep evil at bay and prevent mass destruction on a global scale.

programme.title: Red Beard (Akahige)
programme.desc: The film follows Dr. Kyojo Niide, known as Red Beard, who runs a charity clinic in Edo (now Tokyo). Red Beard is a stern but compassionate physician dedicated to helping the poor and downtrodden. The story revolves around his interactions with a young, arrogant medical student named Yasumoto, who starts working at the clinic under Red Beard's mentorship. Initially, Yasumoto is disdainful and lacks empathy, driven by his ambition and elitist attitude.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Al Leong
programme.desc: Al Leong is considered one of the most impressive kung fu practitioners of our generation. In the early 1970s, when kung fu was barely on the map, Leong stepped into the tournament circuit and became one of the most dominant figures in martial arts history. With his long, wavy hair, his prominent Fu Manchu moustache and wielding one of the heaviest of weapons (the kwan do), he paved a path for the rest of kung fu to follow.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 5
programme.desc: "The lone wolf receives an assassination request to eliminate a feudal lord from a member of his own clan. The Yagyus are using this opportunity to hunt down the lone wolf and exploit the clan's weakness at the same time."

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Yagyus continue to use any method necessary to kill the lone wolf. Meanwhile, Ogami is shocked to receive an assassination request from a woman with uncanny resemblance to his late wife.

programme.title: 52 Masters: RON THOMAS
programme.desc: Will gets all choked up when he trains with fellow Karate Kid franchise veteran Ron Thomas (Karate Kid, Cobra Kai).

programme.title: Soldier Champion aka American Force 6: Soldier Champion
programme.desc: Escape is the only way to survive. Larry Rourke, leader of the resistance to an oppressive South-Asian country, escapes a prison for political dissidents, but it is all part of a master-plan by the head of the prison, who intends to use him to locate the rebel headquarters. Joined by an anti-government cult, the Full Moon Alliance, Rourke must ensure that the government's armies do not catch them before they can find salvation.

programme.title: Three Avengers
programme.desc: When two acrobats are fired for fighting with punks in the audience, they go to live with an aunt who's being pressured to sell her house for a real estate development. The developer's nasty son, Lee Fu, decides to muscle the sale.

programme.title: 52 Masters: LUA aka KAIHEWALU LUA with Michelle Manu
programme.desc: Will spends time with his friend Michelle Manu, a master of the devastating Hawaiian martial art of Kaihewalu Lua.

programme.title: The Magnificent Duo
programme.desc: Leopard, seeks to dominate the opium market. Who can stop him? The Magnificent Duo is ready and willing to take on the gangsters and their Japanese ninja allies in their righteous fight to stand up for the poor and challenge the wicked.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: James Lew
programme.desc: Winning the Emmy Award for Most Outstanding Stunt Coordinator for the "Luke Cage" Marvel series, James Lew began his career as one of the greatest forms and weapons competitors in the tournament circuit of the 1970s. Gracing the cover of countless magazines, Lew teamed up with Carrie Ogawa-Wong to become the greatest duo performance team in history. This earned them the cover of Inside Kung Fu magazine which became the most popular action cover of all time.

programme.title: Raging Rivals
programme.desc: Shanghai in chaos at the turn of the century, a place where gangsters gather and commit all manner of evils. Ghost Kick Silver Fox faces off against the Shanghai Tigers in a battle for control of the lucrative casinos and brothels, but the victor will be the one who ultimately can train the best kung fu killers.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Steve Sexton
programme.desc: Steve "Roadhouse" Sexton is a man who put his martial arts skills to the test everyday. An instructor in Korean Hapkido, Sexton was also the muscle for many bars and places where "tough guys" gather. These are the stories of a man who was shot at, and stabbed but used his martial arts skills to overcome some of the most deadly encounters.

programme.title: 52 Masters: GERALD OKAMURA
programme.desc: Will's lesson with Kung Fu master and martial arts film star Gerald Okamura (G.I. Joe Rise of Cobra, Big Trouble in Little China) takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Green Dragon Inn
programme.desc: When an evil land baron's son murders an innocent family, a Marshal is called in to escort him to be executed in the court of law far to the north. With the aid of an army of soldiers, the Marshal must fight off the Land Baron's assassins.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Art Camacho
programme.desc: Art Camacho is one of the premiere filmmakers in the martial arts industry. From a stuntman to a fight choreographer to the director's chair, Camacho's career includes over 22 film projects wit 36 credits in producing, acting and stuntwork. An award-winning film director, Camacho provides a candid interview about growing up Hispanic, the failures he faced, the influence Bruce Lee played on his life and what it took to break into the film industry.

programme.title: Ninja Operation 2 - Way of Challenge
programme.desc: Sword of Catastrophe is stolen by the Black Ninja, who seeks to free the sword's energy and become all-powerful. Only Ninja Gordon can prevent this catastrophe, but in his search for the secret he comes across an unlikely crew of ninja misfits, who teach him the way to defeat the Black Ninja's dark skills.

programme.title: No todo lo que brilla es oro
programme.desc: Una joven cantante conoce a un hombre, se enamora y le pide que sea su nuevo representante. Él la mete al mundo de las drogas arruinando su vida y la de su familia.

programme.title: Lo que no fue en tu año
programme.desc: Un hombre recién casado comienza a desconfiar de su esposa, pues descubre que no le dijo su verdadero nombre. El hombre le pide ayuda a un amigo para investigar a su mujer, ella finalmente le cuenta la verdad.

programme.title: Homenaje a Roberto Gómez
programme.desc: Poncho se queda dormido en la cafetería. En sus sueños se vuelve el Poncholín colorado y el Poncho del ocho, un homenaje a los personajes, situaciones y formas cómicas del famoso autor.

programme.title: El amor que se hace nudo
programme.desc: Un joven festeja su despedida de soltero con sus amigos y termina en casa de una chica que conoció en el bar. El joven les cuenta a sus amigos que ella lo acosa y agrede a su novia. El joven le confiesa a su novia lo que pasó y ella termina con él.

programme.title: Donde hubo fuego
programme.desc: Rogelio, un hombre comprometido con su novia, se reencuentra con Susana, su primer amor. Después de dudar y estar en una incertidumbre, se ve con Nadia y platican sobre el añorado primer amor que vivieron, dejando en claro sus sentimientos.

programme.title: El que nace pa' maceta
programme.desc: Un joven que sufre de sordera es maltratado por sus compañeros de la escuela y su familia. El chico vive con sus tíos, su tía lo odia y le exige a su esposo correrlo de la casa. La maestra del chico y una niña tratan de ayudarlo.

programme.title: El Valiente Vive, hasta que el Cobarde Quiere
programme.desc: Un joven es abusivo con sus compañeros de la escuela golpeándolos y quitándoles todo su dinero. El joven, su madre y hermano son maltratados por su padre lo que provoca que el chico sea tan agresivo.

programme.title: Ojos que no ven
programme.desc: Lucía es una chica que descubre la infidelidad de su novio. Lucía tiene una infección en los ojos y su madre compra un medicamento económico que le provoca ceguera. La joven culpa a su mamá de su desgracia, pero pronto su vida cambiará.

programme.title: No todo lo que brilla es oro
programme.desc: Una joven cantante conoce a un hombre, se enamora y le pide que sea su nuevo representante. Él la mete al mundo de las drogas arruinando su vida y la de su familia.

programme.title: Lo que no fue en tu año
programme.desc: Un hombre recién casado comienza a desconfiar de su esposa, pues descubre que no le dijo su verdadero nombre. El hombre le pide ayuda a un amigo para investigar a su mujer, ella finalmente le cuenta la verdad.

programme.desc: Poncho se queda dormido en la cafetería. En sus sueños se vuelve el Poncholín colorado y el Poncho del ocho, un homenaje a los personajes, situaciones y formas cómicas del famoso autor.

programme.title: Lucha Interna
programme.desc: Le dan trato preferencial a Lucha y hasta un famoso narcotraficante se pone a sus órdenes porque cree que mató a un delincuente. Albertano se corta un mechón por el cual le dan mucho dinero. Lucha se enoja muchísimo al enterarse.

programme.title: El súper episodio del súper
programme.desc: La familia Peluche va al supermercado y luchan por un lugar de estacionamiento. Federica se pone celosa de que Ludovico habla gustosamente con la señorita de la carnicería.

programme.title: Juego de roles
programme.desc: Federica intenta seducir a Ludovico, pero él no se da cuenta y ella llora porque perdieron la llama de la pasión. Ludovico y Federica buscan como reavivar su matrimonio y hacen un juego de cambio de personalidad.

programme.title: Pacosterona
programme.desc: Paco tiene una falla en la intimidad con Simone, así que Betochas le recomienda una uróloga de primera.

programme.title: Tulum, tenemos un problema
programme.desc: Mientras Simone se va a Riviera Maya, Paco la espía en redes sociales.

programme.title: La jaula de las vecinas

programme.title: Un tatuaje para Alejandra
programme.desc: Alejandra decide irse a vivir con Pedro y Luis porque Magda no la deja tatuarse. Lorena y Frankie le piden a Vanesa que cuide a Benito, pero ella sale y lo deja cuidando a su abuelo.

programme.title: The show must go on

programme.title: Departamento madre
programme.desc: El departamento de abajo queda en renta nuevamente y la familia López buscará una forma de rentarlo. Mientras tanto, hay una oportunidad en el colegio de genios, por lo que Justito podría dejar a sus papás.

programme.title: Fue en un cabaret donde me encontré chafeando
programme.desc: Olegario otorga la gerencia de su hotel a uno de sus amigos, por lo que Plácido regresará a su puesto habitual. Además, la familia López buscará una forma poco usual de recaudar dinero.

programme.title: Patadas de ahogada
programme.desc: Es el cumpleaños de Albertano y doña Lucha le organiza una fiesta, María se pinta el cabello y se pone su más lindo vestido para recuperar a Albertano, le dedica canciones compuestas por ella y le recita un poema. Doña Lucha se siente mal.

programme.title: Angeloterapeuta
programme.desc: Albertano le pide tiempo a María para pensar en el futuro de su relación y ella va con un brujo para pedirle ayuda. Doña Lucha intenta hablar con el chino sobre sexualidad, por lo que van a la fonda de Don Carmelo, donde ella termina ebria.

programme.title: Reparaciones

programme.title: El cumpleaños atrasado de Ludovico

Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Stage 3 - HUNGARY - 2024
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Stage 4 - SERBIA - 2024
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Stage 5 - HOLLAND - 2024 - Part 1
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Stage 6 - HOLLAND - 2024 - Part 2
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Stage 7 - FINLAND - 2024 - World record breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Stage 8 - ESTONIA - 2024
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Stage 9 - PORTUGAL - 2024
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Stage 10 - POLAND - 2024
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Stage 11 - DUBAI - 2024 - Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

programme.title: Stage 12 - DUBAI - 2024 - Part 2
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Stage 13 - CYPRUS - 2024
programme.desc: Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

programme.title: Stage 14 - SOUTH AFRICA - 2024
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Stage 15 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 1
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Stage 16 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 2
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Stage 01 - ICEMAN - Finland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Stage 02 - Latvia
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Stage 03 - Serbia
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Stage 04 - Italy
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Stage 05 - Holland Part 1
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Stage 06 - Holland Part 2
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: Stage 07 - Worlds Strongest Viking - Finland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World's Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Stage 08 - Worlds Strongest Latino - Portugal
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World's Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Stage 09 - Worlds Strongest Truckpull - England
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

programme.title: Stage 10 - Poland
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Stage 11 - Hungary
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Stage 12 - USA Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events - including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal's Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

programme.title: Stage 13 - SCL USA Part 2
programme.desc: It's the final day of the Strongman Champions League's first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120-200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Stage 14 - Dubai Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Stage 15 - Dubai Part 2
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. With fierce competition and last chances to qualify, the stakes couldn't be higher.

programme.title: Stage 16 - South Africa Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals begin in Uppington, South Africa, after a global season of elite competition. Top athletes gather for a dramatic showdown, led by reigning champion and hometown hero Rayno Nel, as they battle in extreme events for the ultimate strongman title.

programme.title: Stage 17 - South Africa Part 2
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World's Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.
